title: Animation
text: Four verbs, added plot: transition_states(states) — marks column whose levels states. ease_aes(ease) — chooses easing (interpolation accelerates). animate(nframes, fps) — compiles keyframes returns vellum_animation. anim_save(file, animation) — tweens encodes frames file. output format follows file extension: .gif looping animated GIF (universally viewable), .png animated PNG (APNG — lossless, transparency), .svg animated SVG. tween, parallel render across CPU cores, streaming encode happen one pass vellum’s Rust backend. .svg writes single animated SVG: every frame emitted vector markup shown turn CSS step animation. Two things make worth reaching . resolution-independent — file crisp slide, retina screen, print, raster format . honours prefers-reduced-motion: reader asked system animate shown first frame, held, extra work . trade-size. every frame emitted full, animated SVG grows number marks times number frames, GIF . wins clearly line art — handful moving marks, common explanatory case — loses dense scatter, raster format right answer. Choose mark count, preference; anim_save() says .svg scene dense enough raster format likely smaller. Serve gzipped (.svgz, web server compression) shrink several-fold.
code: library(gapminder)  vplot(gapminder) |>   mark_point(x = gdpPercap, y = lifeExp, size = pop, color = continent) |>   scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") |>   transition_states(year, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1) |>   ease_aes("cubic-in-out") |>   animate(nframes = 100, fps = 25) |>   (\(a) anim_save("gapminder.gif", a))() p |> animate() |> (\(a) anim_save("draw.svg", a))()

title: Animation
text: viral “bar chart race” needs special API — ordinary transition_states() animation long-format data. bar keyed category, tween slides bars past one another ranks change states, frozen scales keep value axis jumping. coord_flip() makes bars horizontal (familiar racing layout); rank categories within year first want sorted top--bottom.
code: #| eval: false set.seed(1) cats <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E") race <- do.call(rbind, lapply(2000:2006, function(y)   data.frame(year = y, cat = cats,              value = pmax(1, runif(5, 1, 10) + (y - 2000) * c(2.5, 1, 0.4, 3, 1.6)))))  vplot(race) |>   mark_bar(x = cat, y = value, fill = cat) |>   coord_flip() |>   transition_states(year, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1) |>   labs(title = "Bar chart race") |>   animate(nframes = 60, fps = 12) |>   (\(a) anim_save("race.gif", a))()

title: Effects and themes
text: theme sets look everything mark. vellumplot ships several. theme_gray() default (grey panel, white gridlines); theme_minimal() drops panel fill; theme_bw() white panel light grey gridlines; theme_classic() gives axis lines gridlines; theme_void() strips everything marks, legend, titles.
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl)) |>   theme_minimal()

title: Effects and themes
text: theme() overrides individual slots, slot described typed element: element_text(), element_line(), element_rect(), element_blank() draw nothing. Slot names follow familiar dotted scheme (panel.grid.minor, axis.title, plot.title, ), property left NULL inherited parent theme tree. Long category names discrete axis perennial nuisance: side side collide. Two theme controls handle . Setting angle axis.text.x rotates tick labels, gutter reserves extra height automatically; explicit hjust/vjust sets anchor, otherwise end run pinned tick slant clears panel. Left horizontal, long label overrun width tick instead wraps onto multiple lines, label row grows fit — per-tick companion title/subtitle/caption wrapping. Labels already fit untouched, plain numeric axis unchanged.
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   theme_bw() |>   theme(     panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),     plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),     axis.title = element_text(color = "grey30")   ) |>   labs(title = "Fuel economy") gdp <- data.frame(   country = c(     "United States", "United Kingdom", "United Arab Emirates",     "Republic of Korea", "Czech Republic"   ),   score = c(9, 6, 7, 8, 5) ) vplot(gdp) |>   mark_bar(x = country, y = score) |>   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) vplot(gdp) |>   mark_bar(x = country, y = score)

title: Effects and themes
text: Effects change single mark painted, passed mark’s effects argument list. apply stroked point marks. glow() softens widened copy real Gaussian blur neon halo; shadow() adds blurred, offset drop shadow; outline() puts sharp contrasting halo behind mark stays legible busy backdrop. motion() echo() draw fading trail copies marching along direction — speed-blur (motion(), many close copies) discrete ghost repeats (echo()). glow() shadow() real blurs, also work text marks — neon mark_text() needs glyph-stroking: glow() pairs naturally theme_cyberpunk(), dark neon theme.

title: Marks, layer by layer
text: mark_area() fills y line zero, mark_ribbon() fills ymin ymax, interval marks draw ranges: mark_errorbar() (caps), mark_linerange() (without), mark_segment() (x, y) (xend, yend). mark_boxplot() summarises raw y values per x category box--whisker (box Q1 Q3, median line, whiskers 1.5 times IQR, outliers points). Like points bars, summary marks addressable: error bar line range keyed data_id/tooltip carries identity every segment draws, boxplot keys box category — hover, tooltip, select units rendered interactive widget. mark_pointrange() mark_crossbar() identity summary marks: supply y, ymin, ymax (e.g. model’s estimate interval) draw point--range box--centre-line — aggregation.
code: vplot(pressure) |>   mark_area(x = temperature, y = pressure, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.4) |>   mark_line(x = temperature, y = pressure) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_boxplot(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg)

title: Marks, layer by layer
text: mark_abline() draws sloped reference line y = slope * x + intercept, diagonal companion mark_rule()’s horizontal vertical lines. slope intercept may vectors draw family lines. mark_function() draws curve y = fun(x) sampled across panel’s x range — handy eyeballing theoretical distribution data. Overlay normal density density histogram: reuse panel’s existing scales, add top data layer. (mark_function() holds live function, round-trip as_spec().) many observations land (x, y) — common rounded discrete data — mark_count() collapses one bubble sized overlap count, honest alternative invisible overplotting:
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_abline(slope = -5, intercept = 37, color = "firebrick") set.seed(1) vplot(data.frame(z = rnorm(500))) |>   mark_histogram(x = z, y = after_stat(density)) |>   mark_function(fun = dnorm, color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1.5) vplot(data.frame(cyl = mtcars$cyl, gear = mtcars$gear)) |>   mark_count(x = cyl, y = gear)

title: Marks, layer by layer
text: mark_tile() draws rectangle (x, y) coloured fill; mark_raster() thing drawn single raster image (fast path needs complete regular grid). continuous data, mark_bin2d() mark_hex() bin x y grid colour cell count. mark_contour() draws iso-density contour lines 2-D point cloud (mark_contour_filled() fills bands), coloured level. See statistical marks article details.
code: grid <- expand.grid(x = 1:8, y = 1:8) grid$z <- with(grid, sin(x / 2) + cos(y / 2)) vplot(grid) |>   mark_tile(x = x, y = y, fill = z) |>   scale_fill_continuous(palette = "Batlow") vplot(faithful) |>   mark_point(x = eruptions, y = waiting, color = "grey70") |>   mark_contour(x = eruptions, y = waiting)

title: Marks, layer by layer
text: mark_text() draws label aesthetic text (x, y); mark_label() adds filled background behind label stays legible busy marks. size points, angle can mapped constant. crowded scatter, labels collide. repel = TRUE moves apart draws thin leader back point. Placement solved engine device pixels applied absolute offset, drift data scale deterministic (seed needed). offset coordinate agnostic, repel also works faceted polar plots — panel solved labels kept inside . mark_text_path() sets label along curve instead point – one label per group, glyphs following group’s path rotated local tangent. direct way label line without legend, caption contour arc. Glyphs follow tangent, path walked right--left reads upside-– traverse reading direction (sin rising half-period). mark_series_label() legend-free way name lines: puts series’ name end (point largest x), coloured match repelled apart. Map x/y/color lines — label text colour follow series. Give panel little x-room drop now-redundant colour legend. mark_outlier_label() labels points stand — keeps rows whose y outlier (Tukey’s IQR rule, method = "sd") labels just , busy scatter names extremes without wall text. Map label name outlier; color/fill mapped, outliers found within group.
code: top <- mtcars[mtcars$mpg > 30, ] vplot(top) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_text(x = wt, y = mpg, label = rownames(top), vjust = "bottom", size = 9) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_text(     x = wt, y = mpg, label = rownames(mtcars),     repel = TRUE, size = 4   ) t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = 60) curve <- data.frame(x = t, y = sin(t), lab = "y = sin(x)") vplot(curve) |>   mark_text_path(x = x, y = y, label = lab, size = 9, vjust = "bottom", offset = 2) set.seed(1) econ <- data.frame(   year = rep(2000:2015, 3),   value = c(     cumsum(rnorm(16, 2)), cumsum(rnorm(16, 1)), cumsum(rnorm(16, 3))   ),   series = rep(c("north", "south", "east"), each = 16) ) vplot(econ) |>   mark_line(x = year, y = value, color = series) |>   mark_series_label(x = year, y = value, color = series) |>   xlim(2000, 2018) |>   guides(color = "none") vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_outlier_label(x = wt, y = mpg, label = rownames(mtcars))

title: Marks, layer by layer
text: mark_image() puts bitmap (x, y) place marker: flag company logo. src column file paths (one image per datum) single path reused every point. size sets height millimetres, width follows image’s aspect ratio, nothing stretches. Reading images needs magick package (suggested dependency), decodes PNG, JPEG, SVG, . size millimetres rather data units, images keep physical size panel resizes.
code: badge <- function(text, fill) {   path <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")   magick::image_blank(120, 120, color = fill) |>     magick::image_annotate(text, size = 64, gravity = "center", color = "white") |>     magick::image_write(path)   path } d <- data.frame(   x = 1:3,   y = c(2, 3, 1),   logo = c(badge("A", "tomato"), badge("B", "steelblue"), badge("C", "seagreen")) ) vplot(d) |>   mark_image(x = x, y = y, src = logo, size = 14)

title: Marks, layer by layer
text: mark_pie() mark_donut() part--whole shortcuts. value becomes wedge; fill colours slices. hood stacked bar projected coord_polar(), set . polar plots generally, coord_radial() extends coord_polar() central hole (inner_radius) partial start–end arc — e.g. semicircular coxcomb:
code: parts <- data.frame(part = c("a", "b", "c", "d"), n = c(3, 5, 2, 4)) vplot(parts) |>   mark_donut(value = n, fill = part, inner_radius = 0.6) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_bar(x = factor(cyl), fill = factor(cyl)) |>   coord_radial(theta = "x", start = -pi / 2, end = pi / 2, inner_radius = 0.2)

title: Scales and guides
text: Continuous data get smooth colour ramp; discrete data get categorical palette. palette argument takes vector colours single palette name passed grDevices::hcl.colors() (example "Batlow", "Blues", "Set 2"). two-colour ramp, scale_color_gradient() takes endpoints directly, scale_color_gradientn() arbitrary n-stop ramp. coming ggplot2, familiar named constructors simply wrappers palette =: scale_color_viridis_c() / _d() viridis maps, scale_color_brewer() (discrete) / scale_color_distiller() (continuous) ColorBrewer-style palettes. Set limits = continuous colour scale fix mapped range. categories, scale_color_manual() maps levels colours; naming values pins level specific colour. signed anomaly data — value like zero meaningfully neutral — scale_color_gradient2() (scale_fill_gradient2()) draw diverging ramp around midpoint. rescales midpoint, neutral mid colour always lands value even data range lopsided: Ramps built plain colour vector — scale_color_gradient(low, high), palette given colours — interpolated perceptually-uniform Oklab space, sRGB, ramp colourbar read evenly instead dipping muddy, -dark middle (blue→yellow ramp longer passes grey). Designed perceptual palettes default Batlow hcl.colors() name already uniform unchanged. blend sRGB (CIE Lab) instead, set options(vellumplot.color.interpolation = "srgb") ("lab"). gradient fill opts per gradient linear_gradient(..., interpolation = "oklab").
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = hp, size = 3) |>   scale_color_continuous(palette = "Viridis", name = "Horsepower") vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl), size = 3) |>   scale_color_manual(values = c("4" = "#1b9e77", "6" = "#d95f02", "8" = "#7570b3")) anom <- data.frame(x = 1:20, y = 1:20, resid = seq(-3, 6, length.out = 20)) vplot(anom) |>   mark_point(x = x, y = y, color = resid, size = 3) |>   scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "grey90", high = "#b2182b", midpoint = 0)

title: Scales and guides
text: scale_fill_binned() scale_color_binned() cut continuous aesthetic classes give discrete legend, want choropleth heatmap read band rather exact value. Choose classification style ("quantile", "equal", "pretty", classInt::classIntervals() style) number classes n.
code: grid <- expand.grid(x = 1:10, y = 1:10) grid$z <- with(grid, x * y) vplot(grid) |>   mark_tile(x = x, y = y, fill = z) |>   scale_fill_binned(style = "quantile", n = 5, palette = "Mako")

title: Scales and guides
text: Non-colour aesthetics scales . scale_size() maps values linearly marker-size range (mm); scale_shape() cycles set shapes levels discrete aesthetic; scale_edge_width() network edges scale_size() points. shape palette "circle", "square", "triangle", "diamond", "plus", "cross", "triangle_down", "star" — eight , mapped shape covers eight levels automatically. Pass subset (reordering) scale_shape(values = ...). Filled shapes take mark’s fill/color, open marker fill = NA color. scale_size() maps value marker’s radius. bubble charts prefer scale_size_area(), maps area (value 0 → size 0) ink proportional value — honest encoding:
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, size = hp, color = factor(cyl)) |>   scale_size(range = c(2, 9), name = "hp") vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, size = hp) |>   scale_size_area(max_size = 10)

title: Scales and guides
text: alpha linetype mapped aesthetics . scale_alpha() maps continuous variable opacity (range defaults c(0.1, 1)), good way let density show overplotted cloud. scale_linetype() maps discrete variable line types, cycling "solid", "dashed", "dotted", . applies line-like marks (mark_line(), mark_step()).
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, alpha = hp, size = 3) |>   scale_alpha(range = c(0.2, 1)) series <- data.frame(   x = rep(1:20, 3),   y = c(cumsum(rnorm(20)), cumsum(rnorm(20)), cumsum(rnorm(20))),   series = rep(c("a", "b", "c"), each = 20) ) vplot(series) |>   mark_line(x = x, y = y, linetype = series)

title: Scales and guides
text: Sometimes column already holds exact aesthetic values want: actual colour names, sizes millimetres, shape names. identity scale uses verbatim draws legend. variant aesthetic: scale_color_identity(), scale_fill_identity(), scale_size_identity(), scale_shape_identity(), scale_alpha_identity(), scale_linetype_identity().
code: df <- data.frame(   x = 1:5, y = 1:5,   col = c("firebrick", "goldenrod", "forestgreen", "steelblue", "purple") ) vplot(df) |>   mark_point(x = x, y = y, color = col, size = 6) |>   scale_color_identity()

title: Scales and guides
text: scale_x_continuous() scale_y_continuous() control axes. default train data small expansion; override set limits, apply trans ("log10", "sqrt", "symlog", "reverse"), supply explicit breaks labels. Categorical axes use scale_x_discrete() scale_y_discrete(), whose limits set order subset levels. "log10" go — data crosses zero spans positive negative values several orders magnitude — "symlog" gives symmetric-log axis: linear zero, logarithmic tail, ticks zero signed powers ten. set limits without spelling whole scale, use shortcuts xlim(), ylim(), lims() (last takes one named argument per aesthetic): scale_*(trans=) () transforms data: picks breaks transformed space, "log10" axis labelled 1, 10, 100. coord_trans() instead warps display, scale trained — breaks stay original data values, axis keeps labels sit warped positions (gridlines bunch , straight lines curve). Use show data log display without relabelling axis powers ten: x / y takes transform name ("log10", "sqrt", "identity") scales::transform_*() object. applies common marks (points, lines, areas, bars, tiles, smooths, text); interval/segment, boxplot, raster marks warped yet. secondary axis adds second set ticks labels opposite edge (top x, right y), computed 1:1 monotonic transform primary axis. Pass sec_axis() sec.axis argument continuous position scale. classic use unit conversion — plot Celsius, label top Fahrenheit: dup_axis() identity special case — simply duplicates axis far edge, handy reading wide plot either side: transform can formula (~ . * 2), function, scales::transform_*() object, must monotonic. labelling convenience, independent second axis data. currently supported continuous position scales default Cartesian coordinate system, shared scales across facets; combining coord_flip() / coord_polar() / coord_trans(), free facet scales, add_marginal() raises error, plot composition secondary axis drawn.
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   scale_y_continuous(limits = c(10, 35), breaks = seq(10, 35, 5)) |>   scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10", name = "Weight (log scale)") signed <- data.frame(v = c(-1000, -100, -10, 0, 10, 100, 1000), y = 1:7) vplot(signed) |>   mark_point(x = v, y = y) |>   scale_x_continuous(trans = "symlog") vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   lims(x = c(0, 6), y = c(0, 40)) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_line(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   coord_trans(y = "log10") vplot(data.frame(celsius = 0:100, y = (0:100)^2)) |>   mark_line(x = celsius, y = y) |>   scale_x_continuous(name = "°C", sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 1.8 + 32, name = "°F")) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = dup_axis())

title: Scales and guides
text: Date POSIXct column gets date axis automatically. control break interval label format, declare scale_x_date() (scale_x_datetime() / scale_x_time()): date_breaks takes interval string like "6 months", date_labels strftime() format.
code: econ <- data.frame(   day = as.Date("2020-01-01") + 0:729,   value = cumsum(rnorm(730)) ) vplot(econ) |>   mark_line(x = day, y = value) |>   scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%b %Y")

title: Scales and guides
text: Every scale needs legend produces one, vellumplot stacks multiple legends automatically. Map two aesthetics get two guides without asking.
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = hp, size = disp) |>   scale_color_continuous(palette = "Batlow", name = "Horsepower") |>   scale_size(range = c(1, 8), name = "Displacement")

title: Scales and guides
text: guides() overrides single legend without respelling scale. Pass "none" hide , guide_legend() reverse key order override title. Hiding legend keeps mapping; marks stay coloured, guide disappears: override.aes styles legend keys independently data — fix scatter small, translucent points whose keys still want big readable. Pass named list aesthetics (size, alpha, colour, fill, shape, linewidth); swatches change, never marks. continuous colour scale guide colour bar. guide_colourbar() sizes (barwidth / barheight, mm), toggles break ticks (colour), moves labels left bar. binned colour scale draws discrete swatches default; guide_coloursteps() renders segmented bar instead, labelled bin boundaries (takes barwidth / barheight / ticks tunables). size legend defaults stacked keys; guide_legend(nested = TRUE) draws proportional-symbol legend — concentric circles sharing baseline, leader label. reads size directly compact, suits wide size range circles large enough tell apart.
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl)) |>   guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Cylinders", reverse = TRUE)) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl)) |>   guides(color = "none") vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl), alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6) |>   guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1))) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = hp) |>   guides(color = guide_colourbar(     barwidth = 8, barheight = 60, ticks = FALSE, label.position = "left"   )) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = hp) |>   scale_color_binned() |>   guides(color = guide_coloursteps()) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, size = hp) |>   scale_size(range = c(2, 12)) |>   guides(size = guide_legend(nested = TRUE))

title: Spatial and networks
text: mark_sf() draws geometry column sf object. Points, lines, polygons render appropriately, x/y encodings: coordinates come geometry. aesthetics map feature attributes usual, fill = AREA gives choropleth. Pair coord_sf(), reprojects every layer common CRS training locks map aspect ratio nothing stretched. mark_sf() ordinary layer, can stack : draw base layer boundaries, second mark_sf() highlighted features point locations top, every layer reprojects together. mark_sf_label() names feature interior point (sf::st_point_on_surface(), guaranteed fall inside polygon rather bay hole). label positions reproject coord_sf() CRS geometry, always land feature drawn, crowded labels repel apart. several small features share value — counties grouped region, tracts district — borders usually noise: want one clean outline per group, mesh internal seams. merge = TRUE dissolves -fill group single region real boolean geometry (vellum::vl_path_op()), shared edges vanish region one crisp path stays exact PDF (double-stroked seams, hairline gaps). Merging static choropleths; interactive layer ignored, since dissolving features drop per-feature keys tooltip needs. map usually wants polygons: graticule place globe, scale bar read distances, north arrow. coord_sf(graticule = TRUE) draws meridians parallels behind marks — generated longitude/latitude reprojected, curve correctly projected CRS rather drawn naive straight grid. mark_scalebar() mark_compass() fixed-position decorations pinned panel corner (position = "bottomleft", "topright", ); scale bar reads map’s CRS size , defaulting round distance near quarter panel width.
code: nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE) vplot(nc) |>   mark_sf(fill = BIR74) |>   scale_fill_binned(style = "quantile", n = 6, palette = "Batlow") |>   coord_sf() vplot(nc) |>   mark_sf(fill = AREA) |>   mark_sf_label(label = NAME, size = 5) |>   coord_sf() nc$region <- cut(sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_centroid(sf::st_geometry(nc)))[, 1],   4,   labels = c("west", "midwest", "mideast", "east") ) vplot(nc) |>   mark_sf(fill = region, merge = TRUE, color = "white") |>   coord_sf() vplot(nc) |>   mark_sf(fill = BIR74, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) |>   scale_fill_binned(style = "quantile", n = 6, palette = "Batlow") |>   coord_sf(crs = 5070, graticule = TRUE) |>   mark_scalebar(unit = "km") |>   mark_compass()

title: Spatial and networks
text: vgraph() starts node-link diagram igraph graph. runs layout (stress majorization default, via graphlayouts) produces spec whose node edge tables already carry x, y, xend, yend, name columns graph marks need. mark_edges() mark_nodes() draw . Draw order fixed matter pipe : edges nodes labels. node edge aesthetics ones already know. mark_nodes() takes size, shape, fill, color; mark_edges() takes color, linewidth, linetype, alpha. mark_node_text() adds vertex labels. Edge colour, opacity, line type, width train scales – scale_edge_color(), scale_edge_alpha(), scale_edge_linetype(), scale_edge_width() – separate node colour/alpha/linetype scales. figure can map node fill discrete community edge colour continuous edge weight, gets legend instead two collapsing one. Map edge attribute color trained edge scale automatically; call scale_edge_color() choose palette. directed graphs, arrow = TRUE draws closed arrowhead edge’s target end; edges capped node boundary head never buried marker. Pass vellum::vl_arrow() full control head (ends, type, length, angle). mark_edge_text() labels edges midpoints, angle = "along" rotates label follow edge. Labelling every vertex real network unreadable, labels sit markers vanish edges worse. mark_node_text() four tools : top_n / label important vertices (e.g. highest-degree hubs) – common “label handful, 34” move one-liner. dist pushes label radially outward layout centre, clears node marker. repel = TRUE nudges labels still overlap apart, ggrepel-style, thin leader line back vertex. effects = list(shadow()) drops shadow behind label stays legible crosses edge. mark_edge_text() takes effects. Edges straight default. routing = "elbow" draws orthogonal right-angle steps instead – still straight segments (curved edges deliberate non-goal), stepping along whichever axis endpoints farther apart , top-tree bends downward. natural routing "tree", "sugiyama", dendrogram layouts, keeps node-boundary caps arrowheads. directed graphs, gradient = TRUE fades edge faint source opaque target – direction cue reads without arrowheads (without clutter add dense graph). dense graph, straight edges pile unreadable hairball. mark_edge_bundle() routes bundled curves instead, edges run roughly together merge trunks backbone graph shows . drop-swap mark_edges() – edge aesthetics apply – delegates geometry edgebundle package. type picks algorithm; bundled edges faint default overlapping trunks read density. algorithms trade speed aggressively merge: "force" (default, force-directed) "path" bend edges gently, "stub" tufts endpoint, "mingle" merges hierarchically. directed graph, type = "divided" splits trunk direction. Pass algorithm-specific tuning params, e.g. params = list(compatibility_threshold = 0.5). flow map shows one source fanning many destinations, branches merging trunks whose width grows combined flow – shape Minard used Napoleon’s march cartographers use migration. Give mark_flow_map() one--many (star) graph laid fixed coordinates, name root, map per-edge flow weight. type = "spiral" (default) recommended layout: planar, angle-restricted spiral tree needs edgebundle package. type = "steiner" builds approximate Steiner tree instead (additionally needs package). computed flow mapped onto width_range, widest trunk near root stays legible however lopsided weights . vgraph() also accepts base hclust/dendrogram, coercing tree carries merge’s height. title: Spatial and networks
text: Labelling every vertex real network unreadable, labels sit markers vanish edges worse. mark_node_text() four tools : top_n / label important vertices (e.g. highest-degree hubs) – common “label handful, 34” move one-liner. dist pushes label radially outward layout centre, clears node marker. repel = TRUE nudges labels still overlap apart, ggrepel-style, thin leader line back vertex. effects = list(shadow()) drops shadow behind label stays legible crosses edge. mark_edge_text() takes effects.

title: Spatial and networks
text: Edges straight default. routing = "elbow" draws orthogonal right-angle steps instead – still straight segments (curved edges deliberate non-goal), stepping along whichever axis endpoints farther apart , top-tree bends downward. natural routing "tree", "sugiyama", dendrogram layouts, keeps node-boundary caps arrowheads. directed graphs, gradient = TRUE fades edge faint source opaque target – direction cue reads without arrowheads (without clutter add dense graph).
code: tr <- igraph::make_tree(15, children = 2, mode = "out") vgraph(tr, layout = "tree") |>   mark_edges(routing = "elbow", arrow = TRUE) |>   mark_nodes(size = 2, fill = "steelblue") dg <- igraph::sample_gnp(15, 0.2, directed = TRUE) vgraph(dg) |>   mark_edges(gradient = TRUE) |>   mark_nodes(size = 2, fill = "grey30")

title: Spatial and networks
text: dense graph, straight edges pile unreadable hairball. mark_edge_bundle() routes bundled curves instead, edges run roughly together merge trunks backbone graph shows . drop-swap mark_edges() – edge aesthetics apply – delegates geometry edgebundle package. type picks algorithm; bundled edges faint default overlapping trunks read density. algorithms trade speed aggressively merge: "force" (default, force-directed) "path" bend edges gently, "stub" tufts endpoint, "mingle" merges hierarchically. directed graph, type = "divided" splits trunk direction. Pass algorithm-specific tuning params, e.g. params = list(compatibility_threshold = 0.5).
code: gb <- igraph::sample_gnp(60, 0.08) vgraph(gb, layout = "stress") |>   mark_edge_bundle(type = "hammer", color = "firebrick") |>   mark_nodes(size = 1.5, fill = "grey20")

title: Spatial and networks
text: flow map shows one source fanning many destinations, branches merging trunks whose width grows combined flow – shape Minard used Napoleon’s march cartographers use migration. Give mark_flow_map() one--many (star) graph laid fixed coordinates, name root, map per-edge flow weight. type = "spiral" (default) recommended layout: planar, angle-restricted spiral tree needs edgebundle package. type = "steiner" builds approximate Steiner tree instead (additionally needs package). computed flow mapped onto width_range, widest trunk near root stays legible however lopsided weights .
code: set.seed(1) dest <- 10 fg <- igraph::make_star(dest + 1, mode = "undirected") igraph::V(fg)$name <- c("hub", paste0("d", seq_len(dest))) igraph::E(fg)$weight <- sample(1:20, dest, replace = TRUE) coords <- rbind(   c(0, 0),   cbind(runif(dest, 1, 6), runif(dest, -3, 3)) )  vgraph(fg, layout = coords) |>   mark_flow_map(root = "hub", weight = weight) |>   mark_nodes(size = 1.5, fill = "grey30")

code: hc <- hclust(dist(USArrests)) vgraph(hc, layout = "dendrogram") |>   mark_edges(routing = "elbow", elbow_at = "start", elbow_axis = "v") vgraph(hc, layout = "dendrogram") |>   mark_edges(routing = "elbow", elbow_at = "start", elbow_axis = "v") |>   mark_text(     x = x, y = y, label = label, size = 1.6,     angle = 90, hjust = "right", nudge_y = -1.5   ) vdendrogram(hc, k = 3) vgraph(igraph::make_tree(31, 3, "undirected"), layout = "unrooted", mode = "equaldaylight") |>   mark_edges(alpha = 0.6) |>   mark_nodes(size = 1.5, fill = "grey30")

title: Specs, agents, and interoperability
text: as_spec() turns plot nested list; from_spec() rebuilds . JSON form wire format. serializer covers encoding-level grammar exactly. Anything portable document carry — custom transform functions, paint/pattern fills, hand-drawn sketch() geometry, secondary axes, sf CRS objects, per-layer data — refused classed vellumplot_unserializable error naming slot, never silently dropped. (Theme one exception: preset name scalar settings round-trip; custom element overrides drop warning, since styling orthogonal data spec.) Data inlined small stored reference (content hash + column schema) otherwise.
code: p <- vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl)) |>   labs(title = "Fuel economy")  spec <- as_spec(p) str(spec$layers[[1]], max.level = 2) #> List of 3 #>  $ mark       : chr "point" #>  $ encoding   :List of 3 #>   ..$ x    :List of 1 #>   ..$ y    :List of 1 #>   ..$ color:List of 1 #>  $ stat_params:List of 1 #>   ..$ auto: logi FALSE  json <- spec_to_json(p) identical(as_spec(spec_from_json(json))$layers, as_spec(p)$layers) #> [1] TRUE

title: Specs, agents, and interoperability
text: serializable spec makes vellumplot safe target LLM / agent generation: agent emits data (spec) validate render trusted code — never eval()-d R. Three pieces support loop. spec_fields() grounds model real columns inferred types: vplot_from_spec() validates generated spec data returns structured diagnostics — machine-readable repair loop — instead traceback: mcp_serve() runs pure-R Model Context Protocol server exposing get_schema, list_fields, render_spec tools. Point agent bundled launcher: vplot_ask() model-agnostic convenience: give responder function (wrapping model MCP client) assembles grounding payload validates result.
code: spec_fields(mtcars) #>    name         type   class n_unique            examples #> 1   mpg quantitative numeric       25    21.0, 22.8, 21.4 #> 2   cyl quantitative numeric        3             6, 4, 8 #> 3  disp quantitative numeric       27       160, 108, 258 #> 4    hp quantitative numeric       22        110, 93, 175 #> 5  drat quantitative numeric       22    3.90, 3.85, 3.08 #> 6    wt quantitative numeric       29 2.620, 2.875, 2.320 #> 7  qsec quantitative numeric       30 16.46, 17.02, 18.61 #> 8    vs quantitative numeric        2                0, 1 #> 9    am quantitative numeric        2                1, 0 #> 10 gear quantitative numeric        3             4, 3, 5 #> 11 carb quantitative numeric        6             4, 1, 2 bad <- spec bad$layers[[1]]$encoding$x$field <- "weight" # a hallucinated column d <- spec_diagnose(bad, data = mtcars) d$ok #> [1] FALSE d$diagnostics[[1]] #> $severity #> [1] "error" #>  #> $field #> [1] "weight" #>  #> $message #> [1] "Unknown field 'weight'." #>  #> $hint #> [1] "Available fields: mpg, cyl, disp, hp, drat, wt, qsec, vs, am, gear, carb." Rscript -e 'vellumplot::mcp_serve()'

title: Specs, agents, and interoperability
text: spec_to_vegalite() spec_from_vegalite() translate plot Vega-Lite specification. bridge covers documented subset; anything map reported (warning), never silently diverged.
code: vl <- spec_to_vegalite(   vplot(mtcars) |> mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = cyl) ) str(vl, max.level = 2) #> List of 4 #>  $ $schema : chr "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json" #>  $ data    :List of 1 #>   ..$ values:List of 32 #>  $ mark    :List of 1 #>   ..$ type: chr "point" #>  $ encoding:List of 3 #>   ..$ x    :List of 1 #>   ..$ y    :List of 1 #>   ..$ color:List of 1

title: Specs, agents, and interoperability
text: bridge covers documented subset; anything map reported (warning), never silently diverged.

what: Provenance: tracing a plot back to its data
title: Specs, agents, and interoperability
text: Every drawn element keeps stable id tying data rows produced . provenance_join() surfaces alongside element’s device-pixel geometry: figure can also carry fingerprint data, verifies data drawn : provenance_payload() exposes element → rows mapping payload host (vellumwidget) can use click--source interaction.
code: pj <- provenance_join(p) pj[, c("id", "mark", "n_rows")] #>                 id  mark n_rows #> 1 layer-1-point-g1 point      7 #> 2 layer-1-point-g2 point     11 #> 3 layer-1-point-g3 point     14 pj$rows[[1]] # the source-data rows behind the first element #> [1]  1  2  4  6 10 11 30 svg <- plot_svg(p, manifest = TRUE) plot_verify(svg, mtcars)$ok # TRUE #> [1] TRUE plot_verify(svg, mtcars[1:5, ])$ok # FALSE — different data #> [1] FALSE

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_histogram() bins continuous x draws per-bin counts bars. Control resolution bins. mark_density() draws smooth kernel-density estimate x filled curve; adjust scales bandwidth. Densities comparable vertical scale, mapping fill group overlaying works well.
code: vplot(faithful) |>   mark_histogram(x = waiting, bins = 25) vplot(penguins) |>   mark_density(x = bill_len, fill = species, alpha = 0.4)

title: Statistical marks
text: scatter shows joint distribution two variables hides one . add_marginal() puts back: draws distribution x along top edge y along right edge, scale panel lines points. vellumplot counterpart ggExtra::ggMarginal(). Unlike marks article, add_marginal() plot modifier rather layer, closer facet_wrap() mark_density(). takes encoding ; reads x y first plain layer (mark_point()) computes margins . type = "histogram" bins values instead smoothing , sides picks edges draw. scatter maps discrete color fill, group = TRUE splits margin way, per-group density sits points matching colour. scatter’s legend already names groups, none added. Margins share panel’s scales reserve space around single panel, version combine facets, flipped polar coordinate system, fixed aspect ratio.
code: vplot(faithful) |>   mark_point(x = eruptions, y = waiting) |>   add_marginal() vplot(faithful) |>   mark_point(x = eruptions, y = waiting) |>   add_marginal(type = "histogram", sides = "t", bins = 20) vplot(penguins) |>   mark_point(x = bill_len, y = bill_dep, color = species) |>   add_marginal(group = TRUE)

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_summary() aggregates y within x category using fun (mean default) draws result. quick way add group means raw data.
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, color = "grey60") |>   mark_summary(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, fun = median)

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_signif() runs pairwise test x groups draws bracket p-value comparison — ggsignif / ggpubr idiom. Add top boxplot violin; brackets stack data y-axis grows fit. comparisons list group pairs test (default: adjacent pair); method "wilcox.test" "t.test"; label p-value stars.
code: set.seed(1) d <- data.frame(   grp = rep(c("ctrl", "low", "high"), each = 40),   y = c(rnorm(40), rnorm(40, 0.4), rnorm(40, 1.2)) ) vplot(d) |>   mark_boxplot(x = grp, y = y, fill = grp) |>   mark_signif(     x = grp, y = y,     comparisons = list(c("ctrl", "low"), c("ctrl", "high")),     label = "stars"   )

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_smooth() fits model y x (per group) draws fitted line confidence ribbon se = TRUE. layers naturally raw points. method chooses fit: "lm" (linear), "loess" (local regression, span controlling neighbourhood), "glm" (family via method.args, e.g. logistic), "gam" (penalised smooth, needs ), "rq" (quantile regression, needs ). default "auto" picks loess small groups gam large ones.
code: vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_smooth(x = wt, y = mpg, se = TRUE, level = 0.95) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_smooth(x = wt, y = mpg, method = "loess", span = 0.9)

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_ellipse() mark_hull() enclose set points single region — way read group separation scatter without drawing every point’s membership. color fill mapped, group gets region. mark_ellipse() draws covariance ellipse (robust t distribution default, "norm" / "euclid"), following ggplot2’s stat_ellipse(): mark_hull() draws convex hull instead. unfilled boundaries default (matching ggplot2); map set fill shade :
code: vplot(iris) |>   mark_point(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species) |>   mark_ellipse(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species) vplot(iris) |>   mark_point(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species) |>   mark_hull(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, fill = Species, alpha = 0.2)

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_line(window = ) transforms line’s y drawing — rolling statistic, running total, lag/lead — computed per group rows ordered x. Pass op name list(op, k, ...). 7-point trailing mean rides raw series: ops cover rolling mean/sum/median/min/max (k, align, partial), running cumsum/cummean/cummax/cummin, lag/lead, rank.
code: set.seed(1) ts <- data.frame(day = 1:120, value = cumsum(rnorm(120))) vplot(ts) |>   mark_line(x = day, y = value, color = "grey70") |>   mark_line(x = day, y = value, window = list(op = "mean", k = 7))

title: Statistical marks
text: Several marks summarise single variable distributed. mark_ecdf() draws empirical cumulative distribution x step, scale-free way compare groups without choosing bandwidth. mark_qq() plots sorted sample quantiles reference distribution (normal default); mark_qq_line() adds reference line quartiles. Points line mean sample matches reference. mark_rug() adds marginal ticks observation, compact companion scatter density. sides picks edges ("b", "l", "t", "r").
code: vplot(penguins) |>   mark_ecdf(x = bill_len, color = species) vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_qq(sample = mpg) |>   mark_qq_line(sample = mpg) vplot(faithful) |>   mark_point(x = waiting, y = eruptions) |>   mark_rug()

title: Statistical marks
text: mark_violin() draws mirrored kernel density y categorical x, boxplot’s silhouette shows full shape group. mark_ridgeline() turns side: density x per categorical y, ridges overlapping many groups fit little vertical space. Use render_plot() write file. plot chunk example Layer marks single panel; scales train across every layer: plot chunk layers Facet grid panels (facet_wrap() / facet_grid()), shared free scales: plot chunk facet Draw spatial data: mark_sf() renders sf geometry column coord_sf() reprojects locks map aspect ratio: plot chunk sf Draw network: vgraph() lays igraph graph (stress majorization default), mark_edges() / mark_nodes() draw — aspect-locked, axes, edges nodes: plot chunk network spec just data — summary() shows structure without drawing: Write file render_plot() (format follows extension):

title: A grammar of graphics on the vellum backend
text: Marks: mark_point(), mark_line(), mark_step(), mark_rule(), mark_bar() (explicit heights, row counts per category), mark_area() / mark_ribbon(), intervals (mark_errorbar(), mark_linerange(), mark_segment()), mark_boxplot(), tiles/heatmaps (mark_tile(), mark_raster()), 2-D binning (mark_bin2d(), mark_hex()), 2-D density contours (mark_contour(), mark_contour_filled()), text (mark_text(), mark_label()), pie/donut shortcuts (mark_pie(), mark_donut()). Spatial: mark_sf() draws sf geometry column map layer, coord_sf() reproject lock aspect ratio. Network: vgraph() starts node-link diagram igraph graph (stress layout default, via graphlayouts), mark_edges(), mark_nodes(), mark_node_text(), scale_edge_width(). Encodings (tidy-eval): x, y, color/fill, size, shape, alpha. Position scales (scale_x_continuous(), scale_y_continuous(); linear log10) auto-trained, expanded domains; discrete band scales (scale_x_discrete(), scale_y_discrete()) categorical axes. Colour scales (scale_color_continuous() / scale_fill_continuous(), scale_color_discrete() / scale_fill_discrete(), _gradient(), _binned(), _manual()), scale_shape(), trained scale_size(), stacked legends. Trained axes, panel gridlines, layering one panel. Faceting (facet_wrap(), facet_grid()) shared free scales, via resolve_scale() lattice. Statistical marks: mark_histogram(), mark_density(), mark_summary(), mark_smooth() (after_stat()). Coordinate systems: coord_cartesian(), coord_flip(), coord_fixed() / coord_equal(), coord_trans() (nonlinear display remap), coord_polar() (pie / coxcomb / radar), coord_sf(). Position adjustments: stack / dodge / fill bars, jittered points. Per-mark blend = modes (CSS mix-blend-mode: "multiply", "screen", …). mark_datashade() million-point density rasters. Annotations: annotate(), labs(), md() markdown titles. Themes (theme_gray() default, theme_minimal(), theme_bw(), theme_classic(), theme_void(), theme_cyberpunk(), theme() / set_theme()) multi-plot composition (hconcat(), vconcat(), concat(), wrap_plots(), inset(), repeat_()). Layer effects (glow(), outline(), shadow(), motion(), echo()) gradient fills (linear_gradient(), radial_gradient()). Pattern (hatch) fills: pattern_stripe(), pattern_crosshatch(), pattern_grid(), pattern_dot(), pattern_checker(), mapped via scale_pattern() — greyscale- colour-vision-safe, every backend. Boolean marks: vvenn() draws 2-/3-set Venn/Euler diagrams solid geometry, mark_sf(merge = TRUE) dissolves adjacent -value regions one. SVG icon markers (shape = d path string .svg file) repelled labels (mark_text_repel(), engine’s overlap solver). Accessibility: tagged PDF output, plot_lint() legibility/contrast problems, colour-vision-deficiency simulation render time, font pinning reproducible text. Animation: transition_states() / transition_time() / transition_reveal(), ease_aes(), animate(), anim_save() GIF / APNG / animated SVG. Output: render_plot() (PNG/SVG/PDF), pdf_pages() (multi-page reports one page per facet), render_all() (parallel batch), plot_svg() inline SVG string (e.g. sparkline inside gt table). Hand-drawn rendering: sketch() gives geometry mark wobbly, hachure- filled Rough.js look (sketch = argument marks, element_line() / element_rect() sketch = slot, plot-wide theme_sketch() one-liner). Generated natively engine, exact works across PNG / SVG / PDF.

title: The plot specification — PlotSpec
text: data data frame. edge_data graph plot (vgraph()), edge table; default data mark_edges(). NULL ordinary plots. layers list layer specifications (one per mark_*()). scales list declared scale overrides. facet faceting specification (facet_wrap() / facet_grid()), NULL single panel. coord coordinate specification (coord_cartesian() / coord_flip() / coord_fixed()), NULL default Cartesian system. resolve named list mapping aesthetic "shared" "independent" (scale-resolution lattice; see resolve_scale()). width, height Page size inches. dpi Output resolution dots per inch (pixels per inch). exported PNG's pixel dimensions width * dpi height * dpi. theme theme (named list resolved element/setting overrides, theme() / theme_*() preset), NULL default theme. labels named list plot/axis/legend label overrides (see labs()). marginal marginal-distribution specification (add_marginal()), NULL marginals. selections list interactive selection declarations (select_point() / select_interval() / add_selection()). filters list filter declarations (filter_by()). binds list scale-domain bind declarations (bind_scale()). clip clip_to() / set_mask() geometry clip (ClipSpec), NULL none. transition keyframe-animation transition (transition_states() / transition_time() / transition_reveal()), NULL. Read animate(); inert static render. ease animation easing (ease_aes()), NULL. source source-inspection declaration (inspect_source()), NULL. Inert static render; host surfaces data rows behind clicked element.

Edges: color, linewidth, linetype, alpha. position channels supplied vgraph() need mapped. linewidth mark_edges(), edge width; constant (via scale_edge_width()) mapped expression linewidth = weight. mark_node_pie(), wedge border width. linetype mark_edges(), edge line type; constant (via scale_edge_linetype()) mapped expression. arrow mark_edges(), TRUE draw closed arrowhead edge's target end (directed convention), FALSE/NULL none, vellum::vl_arrow() spec full control (ends, type, length, angle) – e.g. arrow = vellum::vl_arrow(ends = "", type = "open"). Edges capped exactly endpoint's node boundary (per vertex, size/resolution), head sits node edge; self-loops drawn teardrop loops sized node, head node boundary. routing mark_edges(), edge routing: "straight" (default) "elbow" – orthogonal right-angle steps tree / DAG / dendrogram layouts (still straight segments, curvature). Elbows keep node-boundary caps arrowheads. elbow_at, elbow_axis mark_edges(routing = "elbow"), corner placement axis. elbow_at "mid" (default, S-bend midpoint), "start" / "end" corner source / target – "start" gives dendrogram bracket (siblings share bar parent's level). elbow_axis "auto" (default, longer side), "v", "h" force axis corner steps along. gradient mark_edges(), TRUE fade (straight) edge faint source opaque target – direction cue needs arrowhead (igraph's edge.gradient). Ignored routing = "elbow". auto mark_edges(), TRUE datashade large graph's edges density raster (vellum::datashade_segments()) edge count exceeds datashade threshold, instead drawing edge vector segment — fast, overplotting-honest path hairballs. device-space refinements vector path (parallel-edge offsets, node-boundary caps, arrowheads, teardrop self-loops) apply rasterised edges. blend Optional blend mode (see mark_point()). effects list layer render effects (glow(), outline(), shadow()) applied mark draw time. text marks (mark_node_text() / mark_edge_text()) shadow() applies. sketch sketch() spec giving layer hand-drawn look, NA/FALSE force crisp, NULL (default) inherit. data Optional layer data; overrides default table. type mark_edge_bundle(), bundling algorithm: "force" (default, force-directed / FDEB), "divided" (force-directed direction-split bundles), "stub" (short stubs endpoint), "path" (shortest-path bundling), "hammer" (hammer bundling), "mingle" (multilevel agglomerative edge bundling). Delegated edgebundle::edge_bundle(). mark_flow_map(), flow-tree layout: "spiral" (default, angle-restricted spiral tree; edgebundle ) "steiner" (approximate Steiner tree; also needs interp). params mark_edge_bundle(), named list extra arguments passed edgebundle::edge_bundle() chosen type (e.g. params = list(compatibility_threshold = 0.8)). mark_flow_map(), extra arguments flow-tree builder – edgebundle::flow_tree() type = "spiral" (e.g. list(alpha = 30)), edgebundle::tnss_tree() type = "steiner" (e.g. list(gamma = 0.9)). Empty default. root mark_flow_map(), source vertex flow fans : vertex name (matched node table) vertex index. weight mark_flow_map(), per-edge flow volume (mapped edge column, e.g. weight = migrants). Defaults graph's weight edge attribute, 1 none. width_range mark_flow_map(), drawn branch width range c(min, max) (linewidth units) computed flow mapped onto. Default c(0.3, 3). size, shape mark_nodes(), node size (mm) / shape; constant mapped expression. size also label font size mark_node_text()/mark_edge_text(). fill, color, alpha Convenience aesthetics; constant mapped expression. nodes, fill (color) marker colour; mark_edges(), color/alpha map edge scales. label mark_node_text(), label expression (default vertex name); mark_edge_text(), edge label expression (default – map edge attribute, e.g. label = weight). dist mark_node_text(), radial offset (mm) pushing label outward layout centroid, labels clear node markers instead sitting . 0 (default) centres label vertex. top_n, mark_node_text(), label top_n vertices largest (edge/vertex metric column, e.g. = degree) – idiomatic "label just hubs" filter. NULL (default) labels every vertex. repel mark_node_text(), TRUE move overlapping labels apart force-directed layout (ggrepel-style), drawing thin leader line back vertex. box_padding, point_padding, min_segment_length, seed tune exactly mark_text(). box_padding, point_padding, min_segment_length, seed Repel tuning mark_node_text(repel = TRUE); see mark_text(). angle mark_edge_text(), label rotation: constant degrees, "along" rotate label along edge. NULL (default) draws horizontal labels. expand mark_node_hull(), fraction grow hull outward centroid encloses node markers (default 0.08). cols mark_node_pie(), compositional columns (character vector node-table column names, least two) whose values size node's wedges. inner mark_node_pie(), inner-radius fraction: 0 (default) draws pie, > 0 donut (e.g. 0.5).

title: Network (graph) marks — mark_graph
text: Edge colour, opacity, line type train scales (scale_edge_color(), scale_edge_alpha(), scale_edge_linetype(), plus scale_edge_width()), independent node colour/alpha/linetype scales – plot can map node fill discrete community edge colour continuous weight without two legends colliding. mark_node_text() label-legibility tools dense graph needs: repel = TRUE nudges overlapping labels apart leader lines, dist pushes labels radially clear node markers, top_n/label hubs, effects = list(shadow()) drops shadow behind label stays readable edges. mark_edge_text() takes effects. (shadow() applies text; glyph outline / glow available yet.) Two decorations: mark_node_hull() shades communities convex hull behind graph (grouped mapped fill, drawn edges), mark_node_pie() replaces node markers pie / donut glyphs whose wedges come set compositional columns. mark_edge_bundle() drop-alternative mark_edges() routes edges bundled curves instead straight lines, hairball collapses legible trunks. delegates geometry edgebundle package (install ) draws returned paths edge aesthetics – type picks algorithm ("force", "divided", "stub", "path", "hammer", "mingle") params passes tuning . Bundled edges faint default (alpha = 0.3) overlapping trunks read density. mark_flow_map() draws flow map: single root fans many destinations along smooth, merging branches whose width tracks flow volume (Minard / migration-map idiom). expects one--many (star) graph rooted root, laid fixed coordinates; edge weight drives flow. type = "spiral" (default, angle-restricted spiral tree) needs edgebundle; type = "steiner" (approximate Steiner tree) additionally needs interp. Branch width mapped computed flow width_range. thin point / segment / text marks; igraph need installed use (vgraph() needs ). mark_edge_bundle() mark_flow_map() also need edgebundle package.

title: Statistical marks — mark_histogram
text: mark_smooth() supports several methods: "auto" (default) picks "loess" small groups (< 1000 points) "gam" large ones. "lm" / "glm" — linear generalised linear fits (glm takes family via method.args, e.g. binomial() logistic). "loess" — local regression, controlled span. "gam" — generalised additive model smooth term (default y ~ s(x)); needs mgcv package. "rq" — quantile regression single method.args$tau (default median); needs quantreg package draws fitted line (confidence ribbon). several quantiles, add one layer per tau.

code: vplot(mtcars) |> mark_histogram(x = mpg, bins = 10)  vplot(mtcars) |> mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |> mark_smooth(x = wt, y = mpg)  # local regression with a wider neighbourhood vplot(mtcars) |>   mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |>   mark_smooth(x = wt, y = mpg, method = "loess", span = 0.9)

text: mark accepts reserved, per-row arguments (captured like encodings, via tidy evaluation) make elements addressable — stylable — interactive host without changing static render draws: data_id — per-element data key (e.g. data_id = model). Emitted SVG backend data-key element returned vellum::scene_model(); join key host uses map hover/click back datum, link datum across views. tooltip — per-element tooltip text (column expression constant), surfaced scene_model() metadata. hover_group — field grouping elements linked emphasis (consumed host later phase). hover_color, selected_color — per-element outline colours applied host element hovered / selected (constant, mapped column different marks highlight differently). override widget-wide theme set vellumwidget::as_widget(hover_color=, selected_color=). inert PNG/PDF SVG opened without JS host: plot none compiles renders exactly . Declaring without data_id defaults key row index, element still addressable. currently apply stat = "identity" marks (points, bars, tiles, segments, edges, hexbins, sf features, …); aggregating stats (histogram/count/density) drop , since rows longer map 1:1 elements. flow vellum scene (scene_model() element table, SVG data-key / data-vellum-* attributes, reserved meta key vocabulary) described vellum's "scene contract" vignette (vignette("scene-contract", package = "vellum")).

text: spec_to_vegalite() translates PlotSpec Vega-Lite specification; spec_from_vegalite() translates one back. layered grammars graphics, mapping direct common cases — marks, encodings, scales (domain / log-sqrt type / categorical range / title), bin + count, faceting, inline data, plot title.

title: Convert between a vellumplot spec and a Vega-Lite specification — spec_to_vegalite

title: Convert between a vellumplot spec and a Vega-Lite specification — spec_to_vegalite
text: bridge covers documented subset (see "Specs, agents, interoperability" article). Anything map — polar/flipped coordinates, layer effects, patterns, statistical marks without Vega-Lite equivalent — reported via warning listing dropped features, never silently diverged.

text: g igraph graph (two-column edge-list matrix). layout layout: name ("stress" (default), "sparse_stress", "backbone", "fr", "kk", "circle", "tree", "sugiyama", ...), supplied N x 2 coordinate matrix, function f(g, ...) returning one. ... Extra arguments forwarded layout function (e.g. pivots = sparse stress). augment Opt-vertex metrics attach graph attributes (can mapped – mark_nodes(size = degree) – used filter_nodes). FALSE (default) attaches nothing; TRUE attaches degree components; character vector picks "degree", "in_degree", "out_degree", "betweenness", "closeness", "eigen", "coreness", "components", "community". Never computed silently – vellum guess centrality meant. filter_nodes, filter_edges Data-masked predicates keep vertices / edges TRUE, evaluated vertex / edge attribute table – e.g. filter_edges = weight > 0.5, filter_nodes = degree >= 2 (augment). graph reduced layout, picture subgraph, full layout holes. k_core Keep k-core: vertices coreness >= k_core (induced edges). NULL (default) keeps everything. seed Integer seed stochastic layouts ("fr", "drl"), making figure reproducible. global RNG stream restored afterwards. width, height Page size inches. dpi Output resolution dots per inch (see vplot()).

what: Hierarchy diagrams: sunburst, icicle, treemap, circle-pack — vhierarchy
title: Hierarchy diagrams: sunburst, icicle, treemap, circle-pack — vhierarchy
text: vhierarchy() draws tree space-filling diagram, choosing geometry type: "sunburst" (concentric ring sectors), "icicle" (rectangular partition), "treemap" (squarified nested rectangles), "circlepack" (circles within circles). four take parent list — id, parent (NA/"" root), value (leaf values; internal node's value sum children) — switching type re-encodes data. Like vgraph() / vsankey() returns ready, axis-free, aspect-locked PlotSpec; mark_hierarchy() layer adds.

title: Hierarchy diagrams: sunburst, icicle, treemap, circle-pack — vhierarchy
text: data data frame describing hierarchy (parent list). id, parent, value Columns (tidy-eval): node id, parent id (NA/"" root), value (used leaves). fill Optional column (tidy-eval) colour nodes . Unmapped (default), nodes coloured depth-1 branch lightened depth; mapped, node takes fill value's colour depth fade. type Diagram geometry: "sunburst" (default), "icicle", "treemap", "circlepack". inner_radius Sunburst : central hole radius, fraction [0, 1); 0 (default) fills centre. flow Icicle : direction increasing depth — "" (default), "", "right", "left". lighten Branch mode : far deepest level fades toward white, fraction [0, 1] (default 0.6; 0 = flat colour per branch). Ignored fill mapped. label Label node id? Default TRUE. Nodes small label left unlabelled. show_values Append node's value label, e.g. "A1 (3)". Default FALSE. orientation Sunburst labels : "auto" (default) angles label tangentially / radially fit wedge, force "radial", "tangential", "horizontal". Labels kept upright. root_label Write root's name (, show_values, total) centre? Default FALSE. useful "sunburst". width, height, dpi Page size (inches) resolution. plot PlotSpec.

title: vellumplot 0.9.0.9000 (development version)
text: mcp_serve() now handles one request per process. stdin connection left unopened, readLines() reopened loop saw end--file first line — real MCP client died right initialize. connection now opened held across loop. from_spec() / vplot_from_spec() now honour supplied data spec data block, instead dropping failing later compile opaque “argument must coercible non-negative integer”. spec maps fields (given) data now errors clearly, naming missing references. transition_states() filters layer’s data = per keyframe. layer data (e.g. per-state annotation) subset current state, every keyframe drew states’ rows . layer whose data lacks state column still persists across frames. labs(x = NULL) now blanks axis title (ggplot2 parity), distinct omitting argument. Previously labs(x = "") blanked .

title: vellumplot 0.9.0.9000 (development version)
text: guide_legend(nested = TRUE) draws size legend proportional-symbol (“bubble”) legend: concentric, bottom-aligned circles leader label, instead stacked rows. Best wide size range (scale_size(range = c(2, 12)) |> ... guides(size = guide_legend(nested = TRUE))). guide_coloursteps() (US alias guide_colorsteps()) draws binned colour scale segmented colour bar — bin colours order, labelled numeric boundaries — instead default discrete swatches. Takes barwidth / barheight / ticks / label.position tunables guide_colourbar(): scale_color_binned() |> ... guides(color = guide_coloursteps()). guide_colourbar() (US alias guide_colorbar()) make continuous colour bar tunable: barwidth / barheight (bar size mm), ticks / ticks.colour (break ticks), label.position ("right" / "left" labels vertical bar), top title / reverse guide_legend() already offered colour bar. example guides(color = guide_colourbar(barheight = 60, ticks = FALSE)). mark_sf_label() labels sf feature interior point (sf::st_point_on_surface(), always inside polygon), reprojected coord_sf() CRS mark_sf() labels land geometry. Repels crowded labels apart. Layer mark_sf() choropleth name regions: vplot(nc) |> mark_sf(fill = AREA) |> mark_sf_label(label = NAME). guide_legend() gained override.aes argument (ggplot2 parity): named list aesthetics forced legend keys , independent plotted data — e.g. guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1))) draws large, opaque keys scatter tiny translucent points. Recognised: size, alpha, colour/color, fill, shape, linewidth. key cell grows hold overridden size. scale_x_continuous() / scale_y_continuous() gained expand argument controlling axis padding: NULL (default) keeps usual 5% margin, numeric c(mult, add) sets proportion data range plus constant data units — e.g. expand = c(0, 0) clamps axis exactly data. theme_sketch() now sketch-ifies plot’s current theme instead resetting grey, self-contained chart deliberately axis-free (vwaffle() / vvenn() / vsankey() / …) longer given back grid axes hand-drawn. ordinary axis chart unchanged. Tagged-PDF alt text longer leaks internal identifiers. tagged PDF used make every mark Figure whose Alt mark’s provenance id (layer-1-line-g1) — , mark_text(repel = TRUE) label, internal vl_place handle (repel:panel-1-1:2:0) — screen reader announced strings, one per mark. Marks now tagged artifacts (role = "presentation"), leaving single Figure carries plot_alt() description. Provenance (data-vellum-id) interactivity (data-key) unchanged. Needs vellum ≥ 0.6.8 (keeps figure -artifact described scene). Reported #145.

title: vellumplot 0.9.0.9000 (development version)
text: mark_outlier_label() — label outliers, every point. Keeps rows whose y outlier (Tukey’s IQR rule default, method = "sd", detected per colour/fill group) labels just , repelled apart. Map label name ; none mapped, outlier’s y value label. mark_series_label() — direct labels: name colour series line end instead legend (direct-labels idiom). Maps x/y/color lines; label text colour come series, labels pushed apart repel solver mark_text(). Give panel little x-room (xlim()) drop legend (guides(color = "none")). mark_signif() — significance brackets (ggsignif / ggpubr idiom): run pairwise test (wilcox.test t.test) x groups draw bracket p-value (stars) comparison. Brackets stack data y-axis expands fit . Add top mark_boxplot() / mark_violin(). scale_color_steps() / scale_fill_steps() — ggplot2-parity aliases binned colour scales (continuous variable cut steps). Adaptive knit output. plot knitted (Quarto / R Markdown) HTML target now emitted crisp, selectable, resolution-independent inline SVG; targets (LaTeX / Word) keep default device render. One plot object, best format per output — conditional code. plot_data_uri() encodes plot self-contained data: URI (vector SVG default, format = "png") — ready HTML , Markdown image, email, gt table’s non-HTML backends. Three complete themes ggplot2 parity: theme_light(), theme_dark(), theme_linedraw(). Named palette scale constructors (thin wrappers palette =, easing migration): scale_*_viridis_c()/_d() (viridis maps — viridis/plasma/inferno/cividis/rocket/mako), scale_*_brewer() (discrete) scale_*_distiller() (continuous) ColorBrewer-style palettes, scale_*_gradientn() arbitrary n-stop colour ramp. scale_color_continuous() / scale_fill_continuous() gained limits = argument (direct form lims(color = ...)). named graph-layout registry gained gem, graphopt, dh, lgl (igraph force-directed layouts, now reachable name). vwaffle() — self-contained waffle chart (square pie): grid cells coloured category, category taking share cells proportional count (largest-remainder allocation, cells sum exactly). Works value column raw row counts. position_sina() (position = "sina") spreads category’s points along x quasirandom offset scaled local y-density, cloud traces distribution’s shape (ggforce’s sina). mark_raincloud() composes raincloud — one-sided density cloud (mark_halfeye()) raw observations sina “rain” — one call, forwarding color/fill mapping layers. New reference summary marks (ggplot2 parity): mark_abline() — sloped reference line y = slope * x + intercept across panel (slope/intercept may vectors several lines). mark_function() — curve y = fun(x) sampled panel’s x range, e.g. mark_function(fun = dnorm) density histogram. mark_pointrange() / mark_crossbar() — identity summary marks (point box ymin/ymax, non-aggregating counterparts mark_interval()). mark_count() — collapse coincident (x, y) points one bubble sized overlap count (geom_count() / stat_sum()); size defaults after_stat(n).
