title: vellumplot 0.9.0.9000 (development version)
text: Interop round-trip fidelity: integer stat parameter (e.g. mark_histogram(bins = 20L)) now survives as_spec()/from_spec() JSON integer instead silently widening double (changed spec hash). Vega-Lite export two aesthetics map onto one channel (e.g. color fill) now reports dropped encoding rather silently overwriting . Clearer, earlier input validation across several surfaces: scale_*_binned() rejects non-positive non-scalar n non-scalar style; numeric scale range rejects non-finite bound; coord_fixed(ratio=), coord_polar(start=), coord_radial(start=/end=) reject non-scalar non-finite values; pattern constructors reject non-positive spacing/size/linewidth; mark_rug(sides=) rolling window’s k validated; MCP tools/call tool name returns clean error. previously failed late opaque message (, set_mask(region=), silently ignored argument — now rejected). discrete position axis longer draws spurious minor gridlines outside categories. Legends mixed titled untitled guides longer misalign: guide title reserves title band. NA facet variable now consistently drops row (matching ggplot2) rather creating spurious "NA" panel character/multi-variable facets. Stacked bars/areas tolerate NA height (dropped stack) instead poisoning whole group’s cumulative total. non-finite scale break longer anchors stray gridline, tick, axis label. Serializing preset theme carrying element_*() override now warns customisation dropped (previously suppressed whenever preset set). clip_to() rejects region vertex whose group NA (silently dropped, deforming clip). Several marks longer silently ignore aesthetics document: alpha now applies mark_boxplot(), mark_errorbar(), mark_linerange(), mark_rule(), mark_halfeye()/mark_interval(), mark_smooth() band; mark_smooth() honours linewidth fitted line; text marks (mark_text(), mark_label(), mark_text_path()) honour mapped size (trained size scale, points already ). facet_grid() longer aborts row/column combination data: structurally-empty panel (e.g. histogram cell observations) now renders blank instead killing whole plot. One-sided continuous limits work ggplot2: ylim(0, NA) / scale_*_continuous(limits = c(NA, hi)) now pin supplied end train open end data, rather silently collapsing axis. Numeric variables drawn discrete axis (e.g. mark_bar(x = a_number)) order categories numerically (1, 2, 10) instead lexicographically (1, 10, 2). Overlaying two layers one discrete axis, one mapping factor one character, longer drops mislabels categories. pie / donut (mark_pie(), mark_donut()) constant short x longer errors. mark_edge_bundle() mark_flow_map() now accept documented effects = argument (glow / shadow / outline) instead rejecting every effect. layout = "dendrogram" reports clear “needs connected tree” error disconnected graph instead opaque internal failure. vtable() renders blank cell -short empty sparkline series instead aborting whole table. Non-looping transition_reveal() / transition_time() animations now reach final keyframe instead stopping roughly one frame short. Faceting column whose name syntactic R name (e.g. "Miles per Gallon", common Vega-Lite import) round-trips as_spec() / from_spec() instead crashing. One variable colouring nodes edges now draws single legend. node/text colour edge colour resolve scale — title, levels, palette, vdendrogram(k =) — redundant edge guide folds node colour guide instead drawing second, identical legend beside . Genuinely different node edge colour scales still keep guides (#94). Requires vellum >= 0.6.8, plot_lint() gained everything linter gained : 13 new rules, two vellumplot — colours colour-blind reader tell apart, characters font running machine can draw. Every vellum::vl_lint() argument now comes — exclude accept finding already judged, cvd pick deficiency check, rules run one rule alone, min_text_pt print-resolution legibility floor. Breaking, minor: plot_lint()’s thresholds must named. ... now sits x, optional arguments follow — plot_lint(p, 5) used mean min_text_px = 5 now fails, 5 reaches engine rule name. Write plot_lint(p, min_text_px = 5). usual convention arguments ..., makes cvd =/exclude = reach engine. Findings carry box refer , vellum::vl_lint_overlay() can draw report onto plot rather describing , vellum::vl_lint_assert() can fail test suite . plot_lint() therefore returns four columns (x0, y0, x1, y1); grammar finding scale rather node, box NA. grammar rules registered engine’s rule registry instead stitched afterwards. vellum::vl_lint_rules() lists single_level_scale legend_overflow grammar tag, rules = selects , plain vellum::vl_lint() compiled plot now reports encoding problems alongside geometric ones — plot_lint() thin wrapper rather second implementation. registry rule handed resolved scene, enough rule encoding, compiled scene carries summary trained scales: kind levels legend-bearing ones, couple kilobytes, computed compile already built . Deliberately summary plot spec, 50,000 rows runs past megabyte keep data alive long anyone held scene. leaves scene’s hash, serialised form pixels untouched. composition table carries none — one set scales report — get geometric findings (#147). Requires vellum >= 0.6.7, fixes animated SVG output: duplicate <defs> ids across frames made every frame’s clip resolve first frame’s — hidden one frame cycle, hidden <clipPath> child clips everything away — anim_save(".svg") blinked showed empty panel. release also fixes frames playing reverse. mark_contour_filled() closes bands leave grid. density band whose contour exits estimation grid closed straight chord back start, slicing triangular wedges across panel (e.g. mark_contour_filled(x = eruptions, y = waiting) faithful). Open contours now closed along grid boundary, band fills correct region. mark_scalebar() labels read left--right every corner. right-anchored position ("bottomright" / "topright") 0 distance labels mirrored, putting distance left. now always read 0 left end distance right. mark_sf() longer paints constant color fill. constant fill constant color, polygon fill took stroke colour outline vanished. Fill stroke now resolved distinct channels : fill fills, color strokes.

title: vellumplot 0.9.0
text: First tagged release. Everything included. Merged choropleth regions. mark_sf(merge = TRUE) dissolves adjacent features share fill one region, internal borders -valued features disappear region single crisp path — double-stroked seams, exact PDF. union real boolean geometry (vellum::vl_path_op()), holes multipart features preserved. ignored interactive layer, per-feature keys must survive. Rotated wrapping axis tick labels. axis.text.x / axis.text.y now honour angle — theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) slants labels gutter reserves rotated height (explicit hjust/vjust sets anchor; otherwise end run pinned tick). labels left horizontal, long discrete label overrun tick spacing wraps onto multiple lines instead colliding neighbour, label row grows fit — per-tick companion title/subtitle/ caption wrapping already shipped. Labels already fit unchanged. Multi-page PDFs parallel batch export. pdf_pages() writes several plots one PDF (report slide deck), one plot per page — pages may differ size keeps accessibility tags — splits single faceted plot one page per facet cell. render_all() renders list plots separate files across CPU cores (small multiples, batch export); byte-identical rendering one one parallelises via process forks macOS/Linux (sequential Windows). build engine’s vellum::pdf_pages() / vellum::render_all(). Real blur effects; glow()/shadow() now work text. glow() shadow() drawn engine’s real Gaussian blur (vellum::vl_viewport(blur=)) — one softened, composited layer instead stack N widened low-opacity copies. cheaper smoother, lifts old restriction text glow: mark_text() / mark_label() now take effects = argument accept glow() shadow() (sharp outline() still needs glyph outline text primitive can’t stroke). outline(), motion(), echo() unchanged. glow() layers / blend arguments kept neon look (opacity + composite) longer stack copies. Relative text sizing tabular figures. element_text(cex = ) sets size multiplier cascades theme (base size scaled, rather absolute size every call site). Axis tick labels now set tabular figures (tnum), digit columns keep constant width stop jittering tick tick. Requires vellum >= 0.6.4. Venn / Euler diagrams: vvenn(). Draws 2 3 overlapping sets whose disjoint regions rendered solid geometry — computed engine’s boolean set operations (vellum::vl_path_op()), overlapping regions alpha-composite stay crisp, including PDF rasterised mask degrades. region filled many elements fall exactly combination sets, labelled count. Input named list member vectors data frame logical membership columns. Requires vellum >= 0.6.4. SVG icon markers: shape = <svg>. point shape can now SVG icon — path d string (icon sets ship) path .svg file — drawn crisp vector marker via vellum::svg_grob() instead built-glyph. Pass literal d/file constant icon, map shape give scale_shape(values = ) one icon per level (legend shows icons); size aesthetic scales . vector marker stays sharp zoom PDF, replacing ggimage/ggsvg raster-per-point hacks. (Per-icon interactivity via data_id yet wired — icons render every backend.) Requires vellum >= 0.6.4. accessibility pass. Four pieces make plot legible colour-blind low-vision readers, reproducible across machines: render_plot(cvd = ) renders .png colour-vision-deficiency simulation ("protanopia", "deuteranopia", "tritanopia", "achromatopsia") can see palette fail. plot_lint() flags problems green test suite hides: text legibility floor, colour contrast WCAG threshold, -canvas overlapping labels (geometric rules engine), plus grammar-level mistakes — single-level encoding legend long read. pattern_hatch() adds crisp vector hatch fill (via vellum::vl_hatch()) stays sharp PDF survives greyscale — redundant, non-colour encoding, usable constant fill scale_pattern() value. Tagged PDF now marks furniture (gridlines, ticks, panel/plot backgrounds) decorative artifacts, screen reader skips instead reading every gridline; figure-level alt text (plot_alt()) carries meaning. plot_manifest() fingerprints resolved fonts plot_verify() reports font mismatch distinct outcome (fonts_ok) data mismatch (data_ok) — pixel difference missing font different cause, fix, changed dataset. Requires vellum >= 0.6.5. mark_contour() traces engine; isoband longer needed. 2-D contour lines filled contours now traced vellum::vl_contour() (marching squares) instead isoband package, dropped Suggests. mark_contour() draws contour chained polyline (closed loops closed), mark_contour_filled() paints closed rings level order layered filled-density look. density field still uses MASS::kde2d(); contouring supplied z surface needs nothing extra. Requires vellum >= 0.6.4. Label repulsion works every panel type. mark_text(repel = TRUE) / mark_label(repel = TRUE) now go engine placement solver (vellum::vl_repel()), solves device pixels applies answer absolute millimetre offset. single post-compile pass — second compile — coordinate-agnostic: faceted, polar warped (coord_trans) plots repel correctly, errored “single cartesian panel ”. Labels faceted plot solved per panel kept inside . seed argument now inert (solver deterministic) kept back-compatibility. Requires vellum >= 0.6.4. mark_text_path() — labels follow curve. new mark sets one label per group along group’s x/y path, glyph rotated local tangent — labelling contour, arc, trend line directly instead legend. Split runs usual way (discrete color distinct label starts new run); hjust slides run along path, offset lifts baseline. Emits real, selectable <text> SVG. Glyphs follow tangent, path walked right--left sets label upside-— reverse path flip . Requires vellum >= 0.6.4. Long plot titles, subtitles captions wrap instead overflowing. title / subtitle / caption longer page now wraps onto many lines needs, layout reserves height (previously text ran straight right edge). Lines aligned band’s hjust (left / centre / right), short single-line labels unchanged. Wrapping page content width, measured millimetres compile time. Requires vellum >= 0.6.4 (fixes grobheight() account wrapping sizes band’s track). Keys marks. Now engine can key lines, polygons text (vellum 0.6.x), marks previously made interactive : mark_line() / mark_step() (series one hoverable object; colour mapping gives one keyed line per series), mark_area() / mark_ribbon() (filled band one polygon), mark_text() (data label individually), sf polygon / choropleth marks (one keyed feature ). release also fixes mark_label(), whose rounded background box now keyed label’s hit target — inert — mark_interval() / mark_halfeye(), whose interval bars now carry datum key like slab centre point already . Set data_id= (optionally tooltip=) mark make addressable; mark left without key stays scene_model(), plot’s furniture never becomes phantom interactive elements. Requires vellum >= 0.6.3. Portable plot specs. plot now serializable document: as_spec() turns PlotSpec plain nested list from_spec() rebuilds , spec_to_json() / spec_from_json() JSON wire format spec_schema() bundled JSON Schema. serializer covers encoding-level grammar exactly refuses (classed vellumplot_unserializable error) anything portable document carry — custom transform functions, paint/pattern fills, sketch geometry, secondary axes — rather dropping silently. LLM- / agent-native plotting. spec_fields() summarises data frame’s columns inferred encoding types ground model; vplot_from_spec() / spec_diagnose() validate generated spec data return structured diagnostics (unknown field suggestion, compile error) instead traceback; mcp_serve() runs pure-R Model Context Protocol server (bundled launcher system.file("mcp/server.R")) exposing get_schema / list_fields / render_spec tools agent generates validated data, never executed code. vplot_ask() model-agnostic natural-language convenience three. Vega-Lite interoperability. spec_to_vegalite() spec_from_vegalite() translate plot Vega-Lite specification documented subset (marks, encodings, scales, bin/count, faceting, inline data, title), reporting features map rather diverging silently. Click--source. inspect_source() declares (plot, host flag) host surface source data rows behind clicked hovered element; carried interaction_model() enacted host reading scene’s provenance (provenance_payload()). Self-documenting, reproducible plots. provenance_join() ties every drawn element source data rows device-pixel geometry; provenance_payload() exposes click--source payload host; plot_manifest() + plot_svg(manifest = TRUE) + plot_verify() embed data fingerprint SVG figure can checked data drawn . Map decorations. coord_sf(graticule = TRUE) draws meridians parallels behind map; generated longitude/latitude reprojected, curve correctly projected CRS (straight grid wrong). mark_scalebar() adds segmented distance bar sizes map’s CRS (units "km"/"m"/"mi"/"ft"), mark_compass() adds north arrow; pinned panel corner via position. scale bar compass need sf , require map coordinate system. Keyframe animation. transition_states() turns plot animation levels column; animate() compiles one keyframe scene per state — training scales states freezing , nothing retrains frames (non-reactive keyframe animation) — anim_save() tweens encodes -frames looping GIF, animated PNG, animated SVG (.svg — resolution-independent, honours prefers-reduced-motion; anim_save() advises raster format .svg scene dense enough one smaller) one parallel, streaming pass vellum’s Rust backend. ease_aes() sets easing (linear, family like cubic/sine/elastic/bounce -/-/--direction). Position, size, alpha colour interpolate (colour perceptually, Oklab); discrete attributes snap. transition_time() continuous-time variant — allocates frames proportion time gaps, unevenly spaced times play constant rate. Giving animated mark data_id enables per-element enter/exit: elements appear fade elements leave fade (matched elements tween usual); without stable element set assumed. transition_reveal() wipes plot view left right (“line draws ” animation) growing clip rectangle single compile. See Animation article inst/examples/28-animation.R. Requires development version vellum (vl_render_animation()).

title: vellumplot 0.8.0
text: Flow maps: mark_flow_map(). one--many flow map vgraph() plot: single root fans every destination along smooth, merging branches whose width tracks flow volume (Minard / migration-map idiom). type = "spiral" (default) builds angle-restricted spiral tree  package; type = "steiner" builds approximate Steiner tree (additionally needs ). Edge weight drives flow, mapped onto width_range. Needs suggested  package. Edge bundling: mark_edge_bundle(). drop-alternative mark_edges() routes graph’s edges bundled curves instead straight lines, dense node-link hairball collapses legible trunks. type selects algorithm ("force", "divided", "stub", "path", "hammer", "mingle") params passes tuning  package, computes geometry; vellumplot draws returned paths usual edge aesthetics (faint default overlapping trunks read density). Needs suggested  package (>= 1.0.0). Chord diagrams: vchord(). Wraps weighted flow (//value list square flow matrix) onto circle – one arc per node, one ribbon per flow centre. Directed: node’s arc splits outgoing incoming block, -> b b -> distinct ribbons self-flows loop within node’s sector. direction shows ribbon’s direction fading source target ("gradient", default), stopping short target ("gap"), "". sort, gap, link_color echo vsankey(); mark_chord() exported layer. Removed unused max_overlaps argument mark_text(), mark_label(), mark_node_text(). reserved never-implemented overlap cap nothing; drop call. robust handling degenerate extreme inputs. single distinct value axis coord_fixed() / coord_sf() longer collapses panel nothing; map centred pole longer gets runaway aspect ratio; circle-pack collinear equal-value leaves longer produces NaN coordinates; pathologically deep hierarchy dendrogram aborts clear “deep” message instead overflowing call stack. mark_line(window = ) requires positive integer k. zero, negative, fractional window size now errors clearly instead silently producing wrong (empty) result. computed-constant if_false condition() carried interaction model. negative literal (e.g. -0.5) computed constant (e.g. grey(0.5)) previously dropped; genuine per-row column references now excluded (carried per element instead). faceted layer whose data lacks facet variable still draws every panel, genuine evaluation error longer silently swallowed fallback. mark_point(auto = TRUE) longer datashades warped coordinate system. coord_polar() / coord_trans() >50000-row datashade fallback — bins linear data space — rasterise wrong place; now skipped vector path draws, matching documented behaviour auto marks (line/step/segment/edges). sankey column many nodes errors clearly. column nodes inter-node gaps can fit, node/ribbon heights previously went negative spilled outside panel; vsankey() / mark_sankey() now abort message pointing node_gap. Aggregating stats drop missing summaries consistently, warning. value-summarising bar (mark_bar(y = , fun = ) friends), category whose summary NA (empty group, summary data containing NA function remove ) now dropped warning grouped ungrouped paths, previously treated NA differently. layer mapping color fill also keeps aligned aggregation (fill previously left wrong length). Clearer errors malformed scale bounds. scale_x_continuous(), scale_y_continuous(), scale_size(), scale_size_area(), scale_alpha(), scale_edge_width(), scale_edge_alpha() now reject limits (output range) length-2 vector — , size/alpha/edge scales, non-numeric one — clear message, instead failing later cryptic low-level error (e.g. 'length = 2' coercion 'logical(1)'). scale_size_area() also validates max_size. add_marginal() rejects non-numeric mapping. factor x/y previously slipped marginal computed integer level codes rather data; now errors clearly, character column already . Stricter validation interactivity layout arguments. select_point()/select_interval() reject non-logical toggle/empty (silently coerced FALSE); vgraph() validates width/height like vsankey()/vhierarchy(); area() rejects non-numeric non-integer cell index instead aborting opaque “missing value TRUE/FALSE needed”. mark_text() honours hjust/vjust passed variable. read constant params, value routed variable (vdendrogram() per direction) silently fell back centred, letting leaf labels run edges. .emit_text() now reads value-first, like angle. vdendrogram() leaf labels also get larger default gap. Dendrograms unrooted trees. vgraph() now accepts base hclust/dendrogram gains height-aware "dendrogram" layout plus "unrooted" layout (via graphlayouts::layout_as_tree_unrooted(), needs graphlayouts >= 1.2.5). mark_edges(routing = "elbow") gained elbow_at / elbow_axis elbow can dendrogram bracket (corner parent’s level) rather midpoint S-bend. vdendrogram() one-line preset: bracket edges, leaf labels, direction, k cut tree colour clusters. Also fixes mark_node_text(label = ) explicit label mapping overrides default vertex name (previously ignored). vhierarchy() respects scale_fill_*(). default nodes still coloured depth-1 branch lightened depth, branch now ordinary discrete fill scale, scale_fill_manual() / scale_fill_discrete() recolour branches lighten argument controls depth fade (0 = flat colour per branch). Mapping fill node column instead colours every node variable (discrete continuous, matching scale_fill_*()), depth fade.

title: vellumplot 0.7.0
text: New vhierarchy() space-filling hierarchies — breaking. vhierarchy(id, parent, value, type = ) draws tree four ways one parent list, switching type: "sunburst" (default), "icicle", "treemap", "circlepack". replaces vsunburst() — vhierarchy(..., type = "sunburst") reproduces old radial sunburst, vsunburst() / mark_sunburst() removed. Treemaps use squarified layout; circle-pack faithful port d3’s front-chain packing. mark_hierarchy() exported layer. Sunbursts, polar pies, self-loops render un-mirrored. Requires vellum (>= 0.5.1), fixes sector_grob()/loop_grob() draw y-frame every primitive. Sunburst segment labels now sit wedges (previously landed vertical mirror unbalanced trees), sunbursts wind clockwise twelve o’clock documented, graph self-loops point empty gap vertex’s incident edges rather mirror image. select_point(group_by=) now links whole groups. point selection group_by / fields groups elements sharing column values, hovering clicking one mark highlights (condition() spotlights) whole group — “hover series, light series” behaviour. Implemented emitting group element hover_group, needs widget change; user-declared hover_group still wins. Inert static render. Declarative interactivity (new). Interaction now part plot spec rather something host configured . Declare named selection select_point() (click/hover) select_interval() (brush/lasso), refer condition() (style aesthetic selection membership), filter_by() (show members — point second view selection cross-filtering), bind_scale() (drive another panel’s view, overview + detail). add_selection() shares free-standing selection across views; interaction_model() returns compiled declaration block host reads. Every node inert static render (plot interactions renders byte--byte identically one without), condition("s", g, "grey80") trains scales draws exactly like color = g. Enacted vellumwidget.

title: vellumplot 0.6.0
text: Sankey styling options. vsankey() / mark_sankey() gain show_values (append node’s value label), flow_color ("source", "target", "gradient" — source--target colour fade per ribbon), node_width / node_gap tune node rectangles. Sankey crossing minimisation. vsankey() now orders nodes within column Sugiyama barycenter heuristic minimise ribbon crossings (previously first-appearance order, left many avoidable crossings). reordering deterministic pure R. related fix stacks node’s ribbon slices meet node vertical order nodes connect , removing remaining crossings within fan ribbons. Sunburst rendering fixes. vsunburst() now colours wedges top-level branch (branch distinct hue, lightened depth) instead single colour per ring — sibling branches previously indistinguishable. also starts first wedge twelve o’clock winds clockwise, matching package’s pies/roses (coord_polar) rather starting three o’clock counter-clockwise. Sunburst / radial hierarchies: vsunburst(). new plot type part--whole hierarchies, parent list — id, parent (NA root), value (leaf values; internal nodes sum children). Depth maps ring node’s angular span share parent’s, drawn one batched sector_grob aspect-locked, axis-free square panel (mirroring vsankey()/vgraph()). inner_radius opens central hole (donut/ring sunburst); nodes coloured depth. mark_sunburst() exported layer. See vignette("flows--hierarchies"). Sankey / flow diagrams: vsankey(). new plot type layered flows, built flow list — one row per flow , , value (ribbon width). Nodes union /; node source target makes diagram multi-stage. vsankey(data, , , value) returns ready, axis-free plot (mirroring vgraph()); mark_sankey() exported layer adds. layout computed R-side (longest-path layering, value-proportional node heights ribbon widths, filled Bézier ribbons) deterministic. Flows must form DAG; nodes coloured qualitative palette. See vignette("flows--hierarchies"). Uncertainty marks: mark_halfeye() mark_interval(). ggdist-style slab + interval marks sample/posterior input (many y rows per categorical x). mark_halfeye() draws one-sided density slab point-interval base — median (point = "mean"), thick inner thin outer equal-tailed quantile interval .width probabilities (default c(0.66, 0.95)); mark_interval() point-interval alone. natural fit visualising posterior draws (e.g. ). coord_radial() scale_size_area(). coord_radial() fuller polar system (ggplot2 3.5’s name): besides theta/start/direction takes end sweep partial arc (e.g. start = -pi/2, end = pi/2 semicircular gauge) inner_radius donut hole; defaults matches coord_polar(). scale_size_area() maps value marker’s area (value 0 → size 0), perceptually honest default bubble charts, max_size size largest value. Sankey labels stay -panel. vsankey() now reserves horizontal margin node labels, source column’s labels (drawn left) terminal column’s (drawn right) longer clip panel edge. Robustness new marks. vsunburst()/mark_sunburst() now reject missing negative leaf value clear message (instead cryptic downstream error), mark_sunburst() validates inner_radius like vsunburst() coord_radial() . mark_halfeye()/mark_interval() skip category fewer two finite observations (warning) rather drawing empty interval, reject width = argument (likely typo .width) previously ignored silently. Consistent argument names hole radius / ridge height. central-hole fraction now spelled inner_radius everywhere appears: coord_radial(), vsunburst()/mark_sunburst(), mark_donut() (hole). mark_ridgeline()’s overlap control now height (scale, collided mark_halfeye(scale=), different quantity). Consistent sketch / blend passthrough. mark_ecdf(), mark_contour(), mark_contour_filled(), mark_dotplot(), mark_qq(), mark_qq_line() now accept per-layer sketch = (emitters already honoured ), mark_pie() / mark_donut() accept blend =, matching rest mark surface. Parameterised position adjustments. New position_nudge(), position_jitter(), position_dodge(), position_dodge2(), position_jitterdodge() give mark’s position tunable parameters (bare string like "dodge" still works defaults). Adds three adjustments: nudge (shift every element constant data units), dodge2 (dodge groups actually present x, filling band padding gap — ragged groupings stay centred), jitterdodge (jitter points within dodged slot). position_jitter(width=, height=, seed=) position_dodge(width=) expose previously-fixed jitter/dodge extents. plot using old string positions unchanged. Label repulsion: mark_text(repel = TRUE) / mark_label(repel = TRUE). Overlapping text labels moved apart force-directed layout (ggrepel-style), keeping thin leader line back point. plot size fixed spec, repulsion resolved exactly true rendered panel — two-pass compile reads panel’s device geometry vellum::scene_model(), relaxes label boxes pixel space, maps result back — needs approximation vellum change, deterministic seed. Tunable via box_padding, point_padding, min_segment_length, seed. Limited single cartesian panel now (facets / composition / polar error clearly). mark_line(window = ): rolling / cumulative / offset transforms. line can now transform y per group (rows ordered x) drawing — moving mean/sum/median/min/max window k, running cumsum/cummean/cummax/cummin, lag/lead shifts, rank. Pass op name (window = "mean") list (window = list(op = "mean", k = 7, align = "right", partial = TRUE)); align trailing/leading/centred partial fills edges shorter window line stays continuous. plot without window unchanged. Diverging colour scales: scale_color_gradient2() / scale_fill_gradient2(). three-point ramp (low–mid–high) centred midpoint (default 0), rescaled midpoint (scales::rescale_mid) neutral colour sits chosen value side spans far data reaches — correct scale signed / anomaly data. diverging continuous colorbar also reports midpoint + diverging colorbar descriptor, interactive host can centre value-range filter neutral value. symlog position transform. scale_x_continuous(trans = "symlog") (y) adds symmetric-log axis: linear zero, logarithmic tails (sign(x) · log10(1 + |x|)), signed data spanning several orders magnitude — including zero negatives, log10 show — reads one axis. Breaks sit zero signed powers ten. transform name flows panel scales descriptor like transforms. New group-region marks: mark_ellipse() mark_hull(). enclose set (x, y) points single region drawn scatter — one region per group color/fill mapped. mark_ellipse() draws covariance ellipse (type = "t" robust default via , "norm"/"euclid"), following ggplot2’s stat_ellipse(); mark_hull() draws convex hull. unfilled boundaries default (map/set fill shade ) need least 3 points per group. region’s boundary trains position scales, ellipse bulges past data clipped. mark_smooth() gains real smoothing methods. Beyond "lm", smooth mark now fits "loess" (local regression, span =), "glm" (family via method.args, e.g. logistic — fit ribbon back-transformed link scale), "gam" (penalised smooth, default y ~ s(x); needs ), "rq" (quantile regression single method.args$tau; needs , line , ribbon). default method = "auto" picks loess small groups (< 1000 points) gam large ones, ggplot2. New formula, span, method.args arguments; glm/gam bands use normal interval, lm/loess t-interval. Previously mark_smooth() errored method "lm".   Suggests — gated method errors clearly package absent. Data panels emitted pannable, gridlines tagged. Cartesian data panels (including coord_flip linear coord_trans) now push pannable vellum viewport, gridlines carry role = "grid". inert static rendering lets interactive host (vellumwidget) pan/zoom panel’s marks clip + axes stay fixed hide/redraw gridlines — groundwork axis-aware zoom. Polar / nonlinear-coord_trans panels stay non-pannable. Requires current development vellum. Continuous colorbar filter metadata. continuous color scale now attaches mark’s colour value filter_value element meta, colorbar descriptor (value domain + orientation) gradient-bar grob. Together (via vellum::scene_model()) let host vellumwidget overlay interactive value-range filter colorbar. Discrete/binned colour scales unaffected. change rendered output. Panels now carry scales descriptor interactive hosts. cartesian data panel’s viewport gains meta$scales record — per axis: type (continuous / log10 / discrete / binned / date / datetime), transform, data native domains, tick breaks + labels, time_unit date/datetime axes. surfaces via vellum::scene_model()$panels$meta lets host (e.g. vellumwidget) map device pixels back data values — brush reported view can expressed data coordinates, just pixels. Requires vellum (>= 0.4.0.9000). Internal: trained position scales now also record transform name , date/time axes, time_unit (previously date/datetime nature lost training). change rendered output.

title: vellumplot 0.5.0
text: Rich md() legend titles longer clip. legend built rich title (scale_color_continuous(name = md("Power (hp m^2^)")), labs(color = md(...))) measured title zero width, legend reserved room drawn title spilled page. Titles now measured vellum’s rich text path (vl_strwidth()), reserving space actually occupy. Secondary axes. Continuous position scales gain sec.axis argument fed new sec_axis() / dup_axis(): second set ticks labels opposite edge (top x, right y), computed 1:1 monotonic transform primary axis — e.g. scale_x_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 1.8 + 32, name = "°F")) unit conversion, dup_axis() duplicate axis wide plot. transform formula, function, scales::transform_*() object. Scoped default Cartesian system shared facet scales; combining coord_flip() / coord_polar() / coord_trans(), free facet scales, add_marginal() raises clear error, drawn inside plot composition. plot without sec.axis byte--byte unchanged. Datashading now covers dense lines large-graph edges. mark_line(), mark_step(), mark_segment(), mark_edges() gain auto = TRUE switch (parallel mark_point(auto = TRUE)): past row threshold layer rasterises line- / segment-density field via vellum::datashade_lines() / vellum::datashade_segments() instead emitting one vector per element, overplotted timeseries stacks graph “hairballs” render fast honestly. fallback skipped warped coordinate system (coord_polar() / coord_trans()), keeps vector path. (Area / ribbon datashading yet available, pending area-fill support vellum.) mark_datashade(spread = ) exposes vellum’s post-aggregation spreading: NULL (default, raw output), positive integer fixed pixel radius (vellum::spread()), "auto" density-adaptive dilation (vellum::dynspread()). Datashaded lines segments default "auto" single-pixel marks stay visible. Continuous binned colour scales now interpolate perceptually (Oklab) default. colour ramp built plain colour vector (e.g. scale_color_gradient(low, high) scale_color_continuous(palette = c(...))) blended perceptually-uniform Oklab space instead sRGB, longer passes muddy, -dark midtones drifts hue — ramp legend colourbar read evenly. Designed perceptual palettes (batlow default, hcl.colors() names) already uniform unchanged. Set options(vellumplot.color.interpolation = "srgb") ("lab") restore old behaviour. Gradient fills opt per gradient linear_gradient(..., interpolation = "oklab") (passed vellum). Error bars line ranges now interactive. mark_errorbar() mark_linerange() thread declared data_id/tooltip/hover_group drawn segments, bar keyed datum — appears scene_model() plot_provenance() carries data-key SVG, ready hover/click/select widget (bar’s cap segments share bar’s key). mark_boxplot() already keyed box category; completes statistical marks. mark interactivity declared unchanged. Two shapes scale_shape(). shape aesthetic’s default palette now extends "triangle_down" (downward triangle) "star" (five-pointed star) original six, mapped shape covers eight levels without explicit scale, accepted scale_shape(values=). Requires accompanying vellum dev version. (constant shape = "star" mark already worked vellum gained shape.)

title: vellumplot 0.4.0
text: Categorical datashading one call. mark_datashade() now accepts mapped discrete color/fill aesthetic shades categorically (datashader’s count_cat): category aggregated separately every cell coloured count-weighted average category hues holds, opacity density — see category dominates , mix, colour legend. Category hues come usual discrete colour scale (scale_color_*() apply). replaces old idiom stacking one datashade layer per category blend = "screen". New span/clip arguments clamp density range (absolute limits percentiles) extreme cells don’t flatten rest. Requires accompanying vellum dev version. mark_image() draws images data points. new mark places bitmap image (e.g. country flag company logo) (x, y), replacing usual point marker. src column local file paths one constant path, size sets height millimetres (width follows image’s native aspect ratio). Requires suggested magick package (#33). coord_trans() — nonlinear display transforms. Warps display one position axes scale trained, gridlines bunch straight lines curve axis keeps original data-value labels (unlike scale_*(trans=), rescales data relabels transformed space). x/y takes transform name ("log10", "sqrt", "identity") scales::transform_*() object, e.g. coord_trans(y = "log10"). Supports common marks (points, lines, areas/ribbons, bars, tiles, smooths, text, …); segment/interval, boxplot, edges, raster/datashade marks warped yet raise clear error coord_trans(). mark_violin() mark_ridgeline() longer clip edges. position scales now trained include mark’s drawn footprint – full kernel-density support violin, ridge height (scale) top category ridgeline – tallest ridge density tails longer cropped panel. Explicit axis limits still take precedence. Marginal distributions add_marginal(). new plot modifier draws density histogram panel’s x variable along top edge y variable along right edge, sharing scatter’s axis line (vellumplot analogue ggExtra::ggMarginal()). Pick distribution type = "density" / "histogram", edges sides ("t", "r", "tr"), extent size; group = TRUE splits marginal discrete color/fill mapping matching palette. reads x/y first plain (identity-stat) layer reuses existing density/bin stats, axes legends duplicated. version supports single panel (error raised facets, non-Cartesian coordinate system, locked aspect ratio). Positional constants now render. bare literal coordinate channel (e.g. mark_segment(x = , y = 0, xend = , yend = value) lollipop baseline) now treated constant-valued coordinate rather style param, populates layer’s values trains position scale. Previously y = 0 dropped scale training, collapsing segment’s start onto end (zero-length, invisible), segment-plot errored “Every layer needs x y encoding”. Segment/edge endpoints (xend / yend) now also extend axis domain, segment-plot derives range ends. Affects positional channels x, y, xend, yend, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax. Faster mark_sf() large maps. Non-interactive sf layers now batch features share resolved fill/colour single grob per style group (polygons one evenodd path_grob, lines one NA-separated lines_grob), instead one grob per feature, layer’s bounding box computed single linear pass rather growing coordinate vectors. 40k-polygon grid cut scene compilation ~24s ~0.8s. Interactive layers (declaring data_id / tooltip / hover_group) unchanged — still emit one keyed grob per feature every feature stays addressable. Note: batched polygon group filled one evenodd rule, two -fill features overlap cancel overlap region (property self-overlapping MULTIPOLYGON already ); disjoint features — every real choropleth coverage map — unaffected.

title: vellumplot 0.4.0
text: linetype now works stroked marks. mark_segment(), mark_linerange(), mark_rule(), mark_errorbar(), mark_rug(), mark_edges(), mark_contour() (annotate("segment", ...)) previously ignored linetype always drew solid lines; now honour , consistent mark_line() (#30). annotate("rect", ...) honours infinite bounds. bound -Inf/Inf (e.g. xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf full-width band) now extends rectangle panel edge, matching ggplot2, instead silently rendering nothing (#29). Continuous labels longer group thousands default. default continuous axis legend now renders 4-digit-plus values without grouping separator, years IDs read 2010 instead 2 010 (#27). Pass explicit labels restore grouping. inputs fail fast. design layout area must solid rectangle (area() requires t <= b, l <= r); per-row interactivity value (tooltip/data_id/…) must length 1 data’s row count; add_marginal() requires cleanly numeric column. now errors clearly instead silently mis-rendering. Clearer alt text grid facets. facet_grid() plot’s automatic alt text now distinguishes row column variables (e.g. “Faceted rows cyl, columns ”) instead running together. Compositions can themed. theme() now accepts composition ([concat()] / [hconcat()] / [vconcat()]) styles figure-level chrome — title/subtitle/caption bands, collected legend, panel spacing, tags. Previously composition’s figure chrome always used default theme. sub-plot still carries theme. Gradient fills fail clearly marks don’t support . fill = linear_gradient(...) painted mark_area(), mark_ribbon(), mark_bar(); mark now raises clear error instead leaking undefined paint renderer. Inputs validated front. theme() now checks panel.spacing, plot.margin, aspect.ratio, axis.ticks.length (rejects NA/Inf numeric setting); vplot() checks width/height way already checked dpi; discrete shape/linetype scale categories palette errors instead silently reusing glyph; binned colour scale given fewer two breaks errors instead crashing colorRampPalette(). Valid input unaffected. Legends read consistently. horizontal (top/bottom) continuous colour legend now draws NA key vertical one always . guide_legend(reverse = TRUE) now actually flips continuous colourbar (previously silent -op) longer desyncs binned colour scale’s boundaries swatches. merged colour+shape legend’s swatches now tagged interactive highlight/select. Minor gridlines past outermost breaks use local break spacing end, sit correctly breaks unevenly spaced. Numeric facets order numerically. Faceting numeric variable now orders panels 1, 2, 10 rather lexicographic 1, 10, 2; multi-variable facets order variable’s type. Log/reversed axes. Bars areas scale_*(trans = "log10") ("sqrt") axis draw axis floor instead degenerate shape (zero baseline maps -Inf clamped trained range). descending limit ylim(hi, lo) bar/area longer silently un-reversed zero baseline. Grouped histogram density. after_stat(density) / after_stat(prop) grouped histogram bar now normalizes per group (group integrates/sums 1), matching ggplot2, rather dividing grand total. Clearer errors instead silent surprises crashes. coord_trans() rejects "reverse" transform (-op — use scale_*(trans = "reverse")) rejects bar/area marks nonlinearly transformed axis (zero baseline place log display). Histogram / 2-D bin / hexbin stats abort cleanly -NA input instead cryptic seq() error. mark_raster() z-surface contours reject grid duplicated cell (previously silent transparent/NA hole). Composition auto-tags continue past 26 sub-plots (Z, AA, AB, …) instead NA. mark_area() now stacks. mark_area(position = ...) silently ignored; gains position argument ("stack" default, plus "fill" "identity"), areas sharing x mapped fill/color combine band instead overlapping zero baseline. area fill mapping unchanged. Mapped aesthetics silently dropped now take effect. mapped fill mark_label() colours label background (previously always fell back white); mapped constant alpha honoured per category/tick mark_violin(), mark_ridgeline(), mark_contour(), mark_contour_filled() mark_rug() (previously collapsed one value ignored), mark_rug() also honours mapped color. British spelling works everywhere. hover_colour/selected_colour now recognised interactivity arguments (previously American spelling ), mark_bin2d()/mark_hex() longer add default count fill British colour = supplied. vgraph() warns layout-column clash. vertex/edge attribute named x/y (xend/yend) overwritten layout coordinates; used happen silently now emits warning naming attribute.

title: vellumplot 0.3.0
text: Adopted vellum’s renamed vl_* graphics primitives (vl_gpar(), vl_unit(), vl_viewport()), longer mask grid. NA legend keys size / shape. mapped size shape aesthetic whose data contains missing values now shows “NA” key (colour scales already ). Also fixes crash: NA shape mapping previously errored (Unknown point shape: NA) — now draws neutral circle. 2-D density contours. mark_contour() draws iso-density contour lines 2-D point cloud mark_contour_filled() fills bands (coloured level automatically). default field kernel density estimate (via MASS::kde2d()); map z aesthetic contour supplied surface regular x/y grid instead. Contour tracing uses isoband package (isoband MASS Suggests). Binned position scales. scale_x_binned() / scale_y_binned() cut continuous axis bins — ticks bin boundaries, datum drawn bin centre — reusing binned-colour classification (style/n, explicit breaks). mark_bar() sizes bin width. Rich multi-line text labels. mark_text() now carries rich labels renderer instead flattening : map label = md(<expr>) per-datum styled label (bold/italic/super-/subscript/colour), plain labels may contain newlines (\n) wrap onto stacked lines. Requires vellum’s development version. (mark_label()’s background box yet support rich labels.) Accessibility (alt text). Every compiled plot now accessible image default. plot_alt() returns plot’s text alternative — author-written string new labs(alt = ), prose summary vellumplot generates spec (chart type, x/y/colour/size mappings, observation count, faceting). compile seam plot title becomes scene’s accessible name alt text becomes description, render_plot() output carries role="img" + <title>/<desc> SVG tagged Figure Alt PDF (via vellum). See new Accessibility article. Requires vellum’s development version (>= 0.1.1.9000) accessible SVG/PDF backend. British spelling. mark_*(colour = ) now honoured alias color (previously mapping silently dropped colour scale trained). Added scale_colour_*() aliases scale_color_*() family. Faithful alt text. auto-generated description now matches plot actually renders: honours scale_*(name = ) axis/legend titles, names implicit “count” axis count bar, describes network graph node edge counts instead (meaningless) layout x/y axes.

title: vellumplot 0.2.1
text: Consumes vellum’s new compound native + mm unit (requires vellum >= 0.1.1). Label nudges: mark_text() / mark_label() gain nudge_x / nudge_y (millimetres, +x right / +y ) shift label exact absolute distance, device-resolved nudge constant regardless scale panel aspect. Device-exact drop shadows: shadow()’s x / y offset now absolute distance millimetres (panel-relative npc fraction), drop shadow stays physical distance isotropic non-square panels. Defaults changed accordingly (small -right drop). Replaces previous npc-fraction workaround. Device-space dodge (mark_bar) jitter (mark_point) remain data-space now; converting compound unit deferred (changes existing rendered output needs snapshot review).

title: vellumplot 0.2.0
text: Grammar-breadth release: new scales, mapped aesthetics, legend control, distribution marks, closing conspicuous gaps versus ggplot2.

title: vellumplot 0.2.0
text: Date/time scales: scale_x_date() / scale_x_datetime() / scale_x_time() (y twins) date_breaks (interval strings like "3 months") date_labels (strftime formats). Date/POSIXct columns still get sensible date axis automatically. New mapped aesthetics: scale_alpha() (continuous opacity) scale_linetype() (discrete line types), drawn per element legend. alpha mapped data now varies opacity (previously constant-); linetype applies mark_line() / mark_step(). Identity scales: scale_color_identity(), scale_fill_identity(), scale_size_identity(), scale_shape_identity(), scale_alpha_identity(), scale_linetype_identity() — use data values verbatim, legend. Limit shortcuts: xlim(), ylim(), lims(). Legend control: guides() guide = "none" (hide legend), guide_legend(reverse = TRUE) (reverse key order), guide_legend(title=).

title: vellumplot 0.2.0
text: Distribution marks: mark_ecdf() (empirical CDF step), mark_rug() (marginal ticks), mark_qq() + mark_qq_line() (quantile-quantile plot). Density-shape marks: mark_violin() (mirrored density per category), mark_ridgeline() (overlapping per-category densities), mark_dotplot() (binned, stacked dots). Violin ridgeline carry per-category provenance.

title: vellumplot 0.2.0
text: 2-D density / contour (mark_contour/stat_density_2d); position-binned scales (scale_x_binned); coord_trans() free non-position scales across facets; triple-merge legends (colour+shape+size) NA keys size/shape.

title: vellumplot 0.1.1
text: New exported plot_provenance(): returns compiled-scene provenance table — one record per emitted mark grob, tying low-level primitive back data rows trained scales produced , id matches grob’s data-vellum-id SVG id column vellum::scene_model(). first public consumer provenance metadata (previously internal), substrate interactivity, linked views, accessibility. Row-key provenance now refined per element line, area, ribbon, step, text, boxplot marks (previously point/bar/tile/segment/sf/ edges), record’s rows resolve actual data rows element draws rather whole layer. See scene-contract vignette vellum.

title: vellumplot 0.1.0
text: First release. vellumplot declarative, pipe-first grammar graphics compiles inspectable spec vellum scene, faceting, coordinate systems, multi-plot composition. Everything ships first release.

title: vellumplot 0.1.0
text: Interactivity declarations (host-agnostic; inert static render). mark_*() accepts reserved per-row args data_id, tooltip, hover_group (tidy-eval expressions). flow vellum scene per-element keys/metadata — data_id becomes SVG data-key surface vellum::scene_model() — foundation companion widget uses hover/select/linking. plot without compiles renders exactly . Applies stat = "identity" marks (points, bars, tiles, segments, edges, hexbins, polar bars) mark_sf() — sf feature (polygon/linestring/point) becomes addressable, keyed element. Per-element interaction styling: marks also accept hover_color selected_color (constant column-mapped), carried scene host (vellumwidget) outlines element colour hover/select — overriding widget-wide theme. Interactive discrete legends: plot maps discrete color/shape scale declares interactivity, legend swatch tagged data series represents, every mark carries series membership. host (vellumwidget) uses make swatches highlight/select whole series. Inert static render interactivity declared. Auto-display: printing plot (composition) draws active graphics device — RStudio / Positron Plots pane, knitr/Quarto chunk — like ggplot2 (via vellum::display()). summary() shows inspectable spec tree instead; render_plot() still writes file. vplot() starts inspectable, serializable PlotSpec. Output resolution: vplot(dpi =) sets authored resolution render_plot(dpi =) overrides per render, exported PNG’s pixel dimensions width * dpi height * dpi. Compositions inherit first sub-plot’s dpi (take explicit concat(dpi =)). Marks: mark_point(), mark_line(), mark_rule() (reference lines via xintercept / yintercept), mark_bar() (uses explicit y heights, counts rows per category y omitted). Encodings captured tidy evaluation: x, y, color/fill, size, shape, alpha. Scalar values become constant aesthetics. Scales: scale_x_continuous() / scale_y_continuous() (linear log10) auto-trained domains ggplot-style expansion; discrete (band) position scales trained automatically categorical x/y (bars); scale_color_continuous() (perceptual ramp), scale_color_discrete() (qualitative palette), trained size scale mapped size. Guides: trained x/y axes (breaks, labels, titles), grey panel white gridlines, legend area stacks multiple guides — colour legend (continuous gradient bar discrete swatches) size legend. Legend layout measured millimetres: guide sized content (title line one row per key), row pitch driven key’s drawn size large bubble keys never overlap, guide block centred legend track. Titles sit directly keys, horizontal (top/bottom) legends pack keys tightly instead spreading across full width, vertical legend uses full figure height. Legend keys match mark: colour legend draws glyph plot actually uses — filled circle point layers, short line line-like layers (line/step/smooth/segment/…), filled square bar/area/tile/ polygon layers — instead always square swatch. Legend geometry themeable: theme(legend.key.size=, legend.spacing=, legend.margin=) set key/swatch side, gap stacked guides, inset around legend block (millimetres). Continuous colour bars now carry white break ticks aligned labels, vertical horizontal (top/bottom) legends. Merged legends: mapping one variable two aesthetics draws single legend whose keys carry encodings — discrete colour + shape become coloured shape keys; continuous colour + size become colour-graded, size-graduated points. Merging follows ggplot2’s rule (title breaks/levels); give one scale different name= keep separate. Layering: multiple marks one panel, scales trained across layers. Faceting: facet_wrap(~var) facet_grid(rows ~ cols) split data panel grid facet strips aligned, shared axes. Scale resolution (resolve_scale() / facet_*(scales=)): position scales shared across panels default; opt "free_x" / "free_y" / "free" (independent per panel) per-panel ranges axes. Statistical transforms: mark_histogram() (bin continuous variable count bars) mark_smooth() ("lm" fit drawn line optional confidence ribbon). mark_bar() y uses count stat. Map computed variables after_stat(), e.g. y = after_stat(density). Position adjustments (position =): grouped bars stack default; "dodge" places side side "fill" normalises group 1. mark_point(position = "jitter") spreads overlapping points. Datashading: mark_datashade() aggregates large point cloud density raster (via vellum::datashade()) fills panel — cost independent point count. mark_point(auto = TRUE) switches automatically ~50k rows. marks: areas/ribbons (mark_area(), mark_ribbon()), steps (mark_step()), intervals (mark_errorbar(), mark_linerange(), mark_segment()), mark_boxplot(), tiles/heatmaps (mark_tile(), mark_raster()), 2-D binning (mark_bin2d(), mark_hex()), mark_text() / mark_label(), pie/donut shortcuts (mark_pie(), mark_donut()). statistical transforms: mark_density() (kernel density), mark_summary() (aggregate y per category), addition histogram / binning / smooth stats. Map computed variables after_stat(). Coordinate systems: coord_cartesian() (view-window zoom), coord_flip(), coord_fixed() / coord_equal() (aspect lock), coord_polar() (pie / coxcomb / radar). Themes: theme_gray() (default), theme_minimal(), theme_bw(), theme_classic(), theme_void(), theme() ad-hoc overrides (panel background, gridlines, text, strip background, legend position, margins). Effects & paints: stroked point marks take layer effects = list(...) argument — glow() (neon halo), outline() (contrasting halo legibility), shadow() (drop / ambient). linear_gradient() / radial_gradient() can used fill value (area / ribbon / bar), theme_cyberpunk() ties glow + gradients + neon palette mplcyberpunk look. Hand-drawn (“sketch”) rendering: sketch() (re-exported vellum) gives geometry mark wobbly, hachure-filled Rough.js look via sketch = argument. Unlike layer effect geometry property, generated natively engine, exact, cross-backend, works PDF. rides three levels, -specific-wins: mark’s sketch =, element_line() / element_rect() sketch = slot, plot-wide theme_sketch() one-liner (hand-drawn gridlines, axes, ticks, marks legend keys paper background). sketch = NA forces element crisp; text never sketched (pair handwriting font). Composition: hconcat(), vconcat(), concat(), wrap_plots() arrange several plots grid; aligned path lines panel edges can collect guides across sub-plots. inset() overlays plot, compose_annotation() adds figure-level titles auto-tags (, B, …). Repeat: repeat_() replicates plot across set fields, zipping one encodings produce composition. Blend modes: marks take blend = argument (CSS mix-blend-mode set — "multiply", "screen", "darken", …). layer composites one isolated group panel earlier layers, e.g. two overlapping translucent layers "multiply". Spatial: mark_sf() draws geometry column sf object map layer (polygons / lines / points), coord_sf() reproject target CRS lock map aspect ratio; scale_fill_binned() / scale_color_binned() bin continuous fill/colour discrete classes choropleths. Network: vgraph() starts node-link diagram igraph graph — runs layout (stress majorization default, via graphlayouts; "sparse_stress", "backbone", "fr", "circle", … matrix/function), builds node edge table, locks aspect void theme. mark_edges() draws edges (straight, batched; reciprocal/parallel edges offset centre line, self-loops nested, optional arrow), mark_nodes() vertices, mark_node_text() labels — fixed edges--nodes draw order. Edges capped exactly endpoint’s node boundary (per vertex, resolution), arrowheads land node edge. scale_edge_width() maps weight edge width legend. igraph / graphlayouts optional (Suggests). Output: render_plot(plot, path); vellum::render(plot, path) print(plot) also work. compiler registered vellum’s as_vellum_scene() seam.

title: vellumplot 0.1.0
text: Compiled-scene provenance (foundation interactivity / accessibility / linked views): every emitted mark grob now carries globally-unique, stable id (surfacing data-vellum-id SVG), compiler builds serializable row-key / scale-ref table — one record per grob tying back data rows trained scales produced — carried compiled scene attr(scene, "vellumplot_provenance"). Populated every compile; additive metadata (raster/PDF output byte--byte unchanged). Continuous integration: GitHub Actions run R CMD check (R release/devel/oldrel Linux + macOS, Rust toolchain vellum backend needs), including nightly run vellum’s main catch cross-layer breaks early, plus pkgdown build.

title: vellumplot 0.1.0
text: Reactivity, 2-D contour stats, algebraic * / + layer combinators. Independent non-position (colour/size) scales across facets yet supported (legends stay shared). network side, community hulls alternative idioms (arc/matrix/hive) deferred.
